races.race_name: Sports4Causes October Club EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Ash Tree
runners.spotlight: 240,000euros yearling who overcame inexperience to score on her debut at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; likely capable of better despite the penalty; firm contender.
runners.comment: Overcame inexperience to score on debut three weeks ago; should improve; firm contender

runners.name: Sorrengail
runners.spotlight: 11-1 and apparent second string when she finished an eye-catching fourth of 11 to a stablemate at Newmarket (6f, good to firm; Speed Of Sound third) a fortnight ago; that was an encouraging first go and she commands plenty of respect with a fair chunk of improvement on the cards.
runners.comment: Eye-catching fourth (Speed Of Sound third) on debut; fair chunk of improvement is likely

runners.name: Speed Of Sound
runners.spotlight: £70,000 yearling who was lively in the market when a close third of 11 at Newmarket (6f, good to firm; Sorrengail fourth) on her debut a fortnight ago; should improve and she's a leading candidate.
runners.comment: Lively in the market when third (Sorrengail fourth) on debut; should improve; key player

runners.name: Sweetwonderfulyou
runners.spotlight: 325,000gns yearling by man-of-the-moment Starspangledbanner; seventh foal; half-sister to winners Maria Branwell (5f 2yo including Listed; RPR 99), Lucky Queen (1m; 70) and Elegant Queen (Scandinavian 7f/8.6f); dam unraced half-sister to useful winners Samminder (6f/7f) and Queen's Pearl (6f); leading yard is yet to fire on the juvenile front but will no doubt click into gear soon enough; market check essential.
runners.comment: 325,000gns yearling by Starspangledbanner; from a leading yard and market check essential

runners.name: Blue Flight
runners.spotlight: Blue Point filly who beat odds-on Godolphin runner by a head to win Yarmouth maiden (6f, good to firm) five weeks ago; open to progress and she's a player even with 7lb penalty.
runners.comment: Won maiden (6f, good to firm) five weeks ago; open to progress and she's respected

runners.name: Parvenue Star
runners.spotlight: Beaten about 5l in a turf novice (6f) and 7f maiden (AW) this month; a bit more is required and she might be one for nurseries.
runners.comment: Beaten about 5l in a turf novice (6f) and 7f maiden (AW) this month; one for nurseries

runners.name: Cut And Sew
runners.spotlight: 260,000gns yearling who didn't achieve a great deal when 9-2 and third of five at Goodwood (5f, good) five weeks ago; still very early days and that initial experience is unlikely to have been lost on her; step forward likely.
runners.comment: Initial experience unlikely to have been lost on her; work to do but step forward likely

runners.name: Perfect Hope
runners.spotlight: Modest form in two starts and she'll be of more interest once handicapped.
runners.comment: Modest form in two starts and she'll be of more interest once handicapped

races.race_name: Flexjet Pat Eddery Stakes (Listed Race)

runners.name: Alfred Wallace
runners.spotlight: Scored at Thirsk (7f, good) on his second start in May and, after finding trouble in the Windsor Castle here, he was just behind Silver Dominion when back to 7f and fifth in Newmarket Group 2 a fortnight ago; might not be much between them again and he's respected.
runners.comment: Just behind Silver Dominion when fifth in G2 latest; might not be much between them again

runners.name: Silver Dominion
runners.spotlight: Narrowly won on his debut at Newbury (6.5f, good to soft) and he was far from discredited when fourth in a Group 2 at Newmarket (7f, good to firm; Alfred Wallace fifth) a fortnight ago; holds a future Group 1 entry and he just about sets the standard.
runners.comment: Fourth in Group 2 latest; holds a future Group 1 entry and he just about sets the standard

runners.name: Time For The Moon
runners.spotlight: He was beaten only 1l when third on his debut in May and made no mistake when scoring by 7l at Musselburgh (7f, good; favourite again) next time; 20-1 when he finished down the field in last month's Chesham over C&D but he has a Group 1 entry and it's way too soon to write him off.
runners.comment: Won by 7l on 2nd start; down the field in Chesham over C&D but too soon to write him off

runners.name: Firehorse
runners.spotlight: Came home well when he registered a winning introduction at Kempton (6f, AW) towards the end of last month; that form hasn't worked out yet but this extra furlong looks likely to suit on his turf debut.
runners.comment: Came home well to win debut (6f, AW); form hasn't worked out but extra furlong should suit

runners.name: Love Is
runners.spotlight: Looked the business when taking six-runner Windsor novice (6f, good to firm) on her debut in May and was then runner-up to a good colt on softer ground 18 days later; had subsequent winners finish around her when 14th of 25 in the Albany last time and now tackles 7f; the sole filly but she can't be ruled out.
runners.comment: Looked good on her debut and not disgraced in the Albany; now tackles 7f; the sole filly

runners.name: Sonny Parvenue
runners.spotlight: 100,000euros breeze-up 2yo who was sent off favourite when showing a good attitude to land 6f Salisbury maiden (good) on his debut six weeks ago; shaped that day as though this extra furlong will be no issue and his yard has won this event with two of its last three representatives; likeable and has to be considered.
runners.comment: Showed good attitude to win debut; extra furlong can suit and yard likes this race; player

runners.name: Dandyman Dan
runners.spotlight: Belied market weakness and 40-1 odds when he made a winning debut at Bath (5.5f, firm) in April; highly tried subsequently, including when a not-disgraced fourth of five in Curragh Group 3 (6.5f, good to firm) four weeks ago; that form was a little dented on Saturday, though.
runners.comment: Not-disgraced fourth of five in G3 latest; that form was a little dented recently, though
runners.owner: Eric Griffiths, Mrs T Burns & Partner

runners.name: Gymbaazy
runners.spotlight: 22-1 and he did well to overcome evident inexperience to make a winning debut at Sandown (7f, good) six weeks ago; that race is yet to produce a subsequent winner but it's traditionally a good maiden and he's an interesting candidate for respected yard.
runners.comment: Evident inexperience but won on debut (7f, good); interesting candidate for respected yard

runners.name: Kach Above
runners.spotlight: The door opened on his third start when comfortably landing Leicester maiden last month and he defied a market drift to make a winning nursery debut at Chester (again 7f, good) a fortnight ago; this is a different test altogether but he's likely capable of better again.
runners.comment: Maiden/nursery winner; this is a different test altogether but likely he can do better

runners.name: Treasurer
runners.spotlight: All three starts at 6f; he posted a promising debut at Nottingham in May and his midfield finish in the Coventry here, when drawn on the wrong side, was better than it looks on paper; stuck to his task well when landing a Salisbury novice (good to firm) at the end of last month, suggesting 7f is worth exploring; by no means out of this.
runners.comment: Coventry run was better than it looks and scored last time; 7f worth a go; not ruled out

races.race_name: John Guest Racing Brown Jack Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Kirchner
runners.spotlight: Ex-French 4yo who was upped to 2m on his third start for this yard when a fine second of 20 in the Northumberland Plate at Newcastle (2m, AW; Synergism third) four weeks ago; 2lb nudge could have been worse and he's unexposed over staying trips; big player.
runners.comment: Upped to 2m on third start for yard when fine second in Northumberland Plate; big player

runners.name: Synergism
runners.spotlight: Progressive sort who won four times last year and has kicked on again this term, landing a four-runner handicap at Lingfield (1m6f, good) in May and third of 20 under 5lb penalty in the Northumberland Plate (2m, AW; Kirchner second) four weeks ago; effectively on the same mark as last time; good chance.
runners.comment: Progressive; third of 20 in Northumberland Plate; effectively same mark; good chance

runners.name: Fireblade
runners.spotlight: Won the Shergar Cup Stayers handicap over C&D last August and he was back to that level when second over 1m6f here (good to firm) a fortnight ago; remains on a competitive mark and needs respect.
runners.comment: Won Shergar Cup Stayers h'cap over C&D last August; good effort latest; competitive mark
runners.owner: Elb Bloodstock Ltd And R L Banks

runners.name: Ghaiyya
runners.spotlight: Career-best form this term includes a win on her reappearance at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm) in April; handicapper might have her pegged now, so this new trip will need to unlock more; still not ruled out.
runners.comment: Career-best form this term but handicapper might have her pegged; 2m needs to unlock more

races.race_name: Sodexo Live! Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Al Azd
runners.spotlight: Has improved for the fitting of blinkers and it was an excellent second of 19 in the King George V handicap over C&D last month; mark took a bit of a knock for that but the form has been working out and he might have an even bigger effort in him; much respected.
runners.comment: Improver for blinkers; fine second at Royal Ascot; 8lb higher but form looks good; feared

runners.name: Fantasy Believer
runners.spotlight: In the veteran stage now but his two runs at York this term prove he still retains ability, latterly when sticking on into midfield in valuable 10.5f event a fortnight ago; his sole start at 1m4f (in December 2024) returned his best RPR and this second attempt is well worth another go.
runners.comment: In the veteran stage now but still capable; second go at 1m4f might induce a big run

runners.name: French Duke
runners.spotlight: Performed respectably in three starts over C&D for Roger Varian and he made a winning stable debut at Meydan (1m4f, good) in January; lesser show at Abu Dhabi followed and he once again raced freely when beaten 17l in the Duke Of Edinburgh over C&D at last month's Royal meeting; hood makes a reappearance, which can be viewed positively.
runners.comment: Won stable debut at Meydan (1m4f, good); lesser shows followed but returning hood may help

runners.name: Study Of Words
runners.spotlight: Wide-margin maiden winner in October; proved a little underwhelming when third on his handicap debut/reappearance at Newmarket (again 1m2f; first-time cheekpieces) in May and disappointed over an extended 1m6f at Doncaster (again favourite) seven weeks ago; no headgear today, which may help, and maybe this trip will be his sweet spot but there are questions to answer.
runners.comment: Underwhelming 1m2f return; disappointed (14.5f) latest; drops in trip with headgear off

runners.name: Merveilleux Lapin
runners.spotlight: Ex-Polish filly who was an unlucky second in Windsor handicap (1m2f, good to firm) on her stable/seasonal debut in May; near that form when fourth of nine in Pontefract Listed event (1m4f, good) one month ago; not hard to envisage another good effort.
runners.comment: Ex-Polish filly who has run well in both starts for this yard; another good effort likely

runners.name: Flying Frontier
runners.spotlight: He was attempting to win a 1m2f Sandown handicap for the second successive year when fourth (Theory Of Tides second) three weeks ago; will need more on this second attempt at 1m4f (finished fifth on AW three years ago).
runners.comment: Fourth (Theory Of Tides second) three weeks ago; will need more and stamina not assured

runners.name: Dancing In Paris
runners.spotlight: Course winner over 1m6f (also has two wins at 1m4f) but he hasn't scored since August 2024; posted a couple of mighty seconds in big handicaps on AW and turf last term but he's yet to get going in two starts this year; dangerous mark if he can stage a revival and the market might be revealing.
runners.comment: Two big seconds in h'caps last term; yet to get going this year; dangerous mark, though

runners.name: Theory Of Tides
runners.spotlight: 1m2f/11.5f novice winner who was purchased out of the Gosden stable for 58,000gns in the autumn; encouraging stable debut when second over 1m2f at Sandown three weeks ago, when he dropped some strong hints the step back up to this trip would see him in even better light; interesting.
runners.comment: 11.5f winner; shaped like return to 1m4f will suit on stable debut last time; interesting

runners.name: Elsass
runners.spotlight: A gelding operation saw him improve to win a pair of 1m3f handicaps in the spring, and following a blip he was back in form when third at Ripon (1m4f, good) on Saturday; that may suggest he's plateaued for now but he can't be readily dismissed.
runners.comment: Gelding operation saw him improve but Saturday's third may suggest he's plateaued for now

races.race_name: Chapel Down Handicap

runners.name: Be Frank
runners.spotlight: Made a winning reappearance at Newmarket (good to firm) last year but this term's comeback wasn't so notable when sixth in an amateur riders' event at Chester (also 7f, good to soft) six weeks ago; this better ground might be more suitable and he's just 2lb above that last winning mark, however; requires a second look with Billy Loughnane booked.
runners.comment: Sixth on return (good to soft) last time; this ground more suitable & Billy Loughnane's up

runners.name: Mr Writer
runners.spotlight: Made the breakthrough when scrambling home in Catterick maiden in May and he broke his handicap duck with another neck success at Leicester (also 7f, good to firm) three weeks ago; up 4lb but he might be capable of better.
runners.comment: Won maiden in May and handicap three weeks ago; up 4lb but he might be capable of better

runners.name: Illy's Roo
runners.spotlight: Three wins at this trip and he was down to his previous winning mark when popping up at 25-1 in 11-runner handicap over 1m at York (good to firm) a fortnight ago; that was a comfortable career best and he might need to better it back down to 7f from 6lb higher; still respected.
runners.comment: Down to previous winning mark when scoring over 1m latest; 6lb higher but still respected

runners.name: Mystic Moment
runners.spotlight: Made all to bag an Epsom maiden (7f, good) for Eve Johnson Houghton last July but she's weakened in three starts for her current yard this year; the handicapper is trying to help and Oisin Murphy also lends his support, however, so any strength in the betting could prove significant.
runners.comment: Handicapper is trying to help and Oisin Murphy also lends his support; watch the market

runners.name: Gallant
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner for Andrew Balding, latterly last June, who hasn't truly threatened on his last four turf starts for this yard; cannot be completely dismissed from this declining mark, though.
runners.comment: Hasn't truly threatened on last four starts for this yard; declining mark, though

runners.name: Tex
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden but he's normally reliable and has been placed on six occasions, including in two 7f Class 5 handicaps in May; bombed out on AW later that month and subsequently absent, while this is a notch above his usual hunting ground.
runners.comment: Normally reliable but bombed out latest and this is a notch above his usual hunting ground

runners.name: H Key Lails
runners.spotlight: Eight-time winner (7f/1m) at a lower level, including when he comfortably made all at Lingfield (7f, good) at the start of last month; 50-1 when he made no impact in this grade at Sandown three weeks ago, however.
runners.comment: Eighth win when he made all (7f, good) last month; no impact in this grade last time

runners.name: King Of War
runners.spotlight: Likes to get on with it and he registered the latest of his six wins when making all in five-runner Brighton handicap (7f, good to firm) last month; went off too quickly next time but his third at Chester was a solid effort two weeks ago; same mark and this is tougher, though.
runners.comment: Won last month and solid third two weeks ago; same mark and this is tougher, though

runners.name: Walson's Law
runners.spotlight: Won twice last summer (1m/7f, good to firm) and it was an encouraging reappearance when third here (6f) in May; saw little daylight at Goodwood a fortnight later but he weakened when last of 11 at Doncaster (again 7f) seven weeks ago; hard to predict what he'll come up with this time.
runners.comment: Encouraging reappearance but he found little last time; hard to know what comes next
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Lady Cobham

runners.name: Wield
runners.spotlight: All starts at 7f; showed ability in the last two of his three runs for Andrew Balding but was beaten 20l on his handicap/stable debut in May; subsequently rested and has been gelded in the interim; unexposed and he's worth a market check.
runners.comment: Beaten 20l on handicap/stable debut in May; subsequently rested and gelded; check betting

runners.name: Havana Blue
runners.spotlight: He recorded the last of his three victories back in August 2024 but his mark had reflected that when very good neck second of 17 over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago; up 3lb but another good show can be expected.
runners.comment: Very good neck second of 17 over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago; big player

runners.name: Dapper Guest
runners.spotlight: He had been getting his act together this term and his penultimate fourth of ten at Newmarket (7f, good) last month suggested his turn was nearing; it didn't come in the Bunbury Cup a fortnight ago but that can be forgiven and he's not without interest back in calmer waters.
runners.comment: Penultimate fourth (7f, good) last month suggested his turn was nearing; latest forgiven

runners.name: Independent Expert
runners.spotlight: Eight-time winner in Ireland (7f/1m) who has yet to sparkle in two 6f starts for this yard, including when beaten 12l to finish last of eight at Windsor (good to firm) on Monday; this trip is more suitable so heed any market signals.
runners.comment: Yet to sparkle in two 6f starts for this yard; 7f more suitable so heed any market signals

races.race_name: Sodexo Live! Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Paradise Walk
runners.spotlight: On the up since blinkers were added, following her 6f maiden win at Windsor with a 5f handicap win at Nottingham five weeks ago; that form looks solid enough and she could have more to offer; up 4lb but should make a bold bid for last year's winning stable.
runners.comment: Chasing a hat-trick after wins at Windsor and Nottingham; still feasibly weighted

runners.name: Desert Treasure
runners.spotlight: 2-2 as a 2yo, winning a 5f maiden at Yarmouth and defying a penalty in a Windsor novice ten days later; down the field in two handicaps this season; dropping down the weights but others look more solid.
runners.comment: 2-2 as a 2yo; neither handicap run this year suggests she is the answer today

runners.name: Lady Roxby
runners.spotlight: Progressive last season and she reappeared with a promising third at Kempton (6f) in April; not so good since but she is on a favourable mark again now and dropping back to 5f can help; contender.
runners.comment: Back to a handy mark; returning to 5f and Class 4 is in her favour; one to take seriously

runners.name: Toolatetonegotiate
runners.spotlight: Not at her best in a Class 3 at Windsor last month but that was 6f and this drop back in trip should help; wouldn't look to have much wiggle room off this mark though.
runners.comment: Below best last time but returning to 5f should suit; perhaps high in the weights for now

runners.name: Killavia
runners.spotlight: Made all in a fillies' maiden at Sandown (5f, good) 12 months ago; not at her best in her two runs this year but she's slipped down the weights and Oisin Murphy is booked; stable won this with a 3yo in 2023; revival could be imminent.
runners.comment: On a good mark judged on best 2yo efforts; Oisin Murphy booked; revival could be imminent

runners.name: Lara Antipova
runners.spotlight: No improvement for the switch to handicaps when fourth of seven at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) four weeks ago; this first crack at 5f needs to spark improvement.
runners.comment: No improvement for the switch to handicaps at Newmarket (6f) four weeks ago; now tries 5f
runners.owner: Moulton Racing And Mrs A Jordan

runners.name: Dandy Magic
runners.spotlight: Solid efforts to finish fourth in each of her last three starts (6f, good or faster), running to a similar level on each occasion; Billy Loughnane takes over in the saddle and cheekpieces are now given a go; she'll need a good pace back at 5f if she is to come out on top.
runners.comment: Running well over 6f this month; cheekpieces now tried; needs strong pace back at 5f

runners.name: Carefree Dream
runners.spotlight: Solid fourth over 6f at Leicester three weeks ago was the latest in a series of good runs; whether she is ahead of her mark remains a moot point though.
runners.comment: Arrives in good form but others have greater handicapping potential

runners.name: Fantasy Obsessor
runners.spotlight: Won her first two starts but she was a beaten favourite in this race last year (handicap debut) and has been beaten a further ten times since; inconsistent in 2026 and the change of headgear isn't enough to tempt.
runners.comment: 0-11 in handicaps; inconsistent in 2026 and the change of headgear isn't enough to tempt

races.race_name: Chloe Mediumship Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: Trouville
runners.spotlight: Respectable Flat form for the Crisfords and has made a bright start over hurdles, winning as he liked last time at Worcester (good); the second nearly went one better next time; a strong contender even with a penalty.
runners.comment: Respectable Flat form for the Crisfords and won as he liked at Worcester recently

runners.name: Likewhatyousee
runners.spotlight: Won her Irish Flat maiden (1m4f) on heavy but it was good ground for her two visits to Newton Abbot and she won by 10l three weeks ago; penalised accordingly but clearly going the right way and her form is up there.
runners.comment: Penalised for 10l win last time; clearly going the right way and her form is up there

runners.name: Biggles
runners.spotlight: Won the Bunbury Cup in 2023; unraced beyond 1m on the Flat but seemed to stay the trip okay on jumps debut here following a long absence; however, what he achieved behind an easy winner in that small field is questionable.
runners.comment: Smart Flat form at his peak; encouraging jumps debut after a long absence
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Lady Cobham

runners.name: Whermyrosemarygoes
runners.spotlight: Placed in her last two Irish points so has ability and Harry Cobden is booked for her rules debut; still likely best watched over this trip.
runners.comment: Placed in her last two Irish points so has ability and Harry Cobden is booked

runners.name: Cool Million
runners.spotlight: Ran okay in two bumpers but it's hard to rate her form too highly; best watched.
runners.comment: Ran okay in two bumpers but it's hard to rate her form too highly; best watched

runners.name: Letmeseethecolts
runners.spotlight: 1m3f/1m4f wins at a lowly level and it was a modest race in which she ran second on jumps debut at Cartmel (good; jumping lacked fluency); others preferred.
runners.comment: Dual Flat winner at a lowly level; also a modest race in which she ran second at Cartmel

runners.name: Miss The Sting
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in a bumper and pulled up in a recent maiden here after a long absence.
runners.comment: Tailed off in a bumper and pulled up in a recent maiden here after a long absence

runners.name: Don De La Frontera
runners.spotlight: Finished last in his two point bumpers when trained by Lily Bradstock; showed more on stable/bumper debut when beaten 12l at Market Rasen but there will probably be other days.
runners.comment: Showed more on stable/bumper debut when beaten 12l at Market Rasen

runners.name: Tracker Issue
runners.spotlight: 15-race maiden off the Flat with a basement handicap mark; no real appeal on hurdling debut.
runners.comment: 15-race maiden off the Flat with basement handicap mark; no real appeal on hurdling debut

runners.name: Zerouali
runners.spotlight: 150-1 when tailed off in a bumper here only 17 days ago.
runners.comment: 150-1 when tailed off in a bumper here only 17 days ago

runners.name: Amalfina
runners.spotlight: Left Karl Burke for 7,000gns and as a seven-race maiden; beaten 49l and 24l in two runs over hurdles.
runners.comment: Seven-race Flat maiden and beaten 49l and 24l in two runs over hurdles

runners.name: Pearl Knot
runners.spotlight: Early casualty on debut; didn't show a lot when beaten a long way here 17 days ago.
runners.comment: Early casualty on debut; didn't show a lot when beaten a long way here 17 days ago

runners.name: Bailey's Luck
runners.spotlight: Beat one home in a 1m AW maiden and was 300-1 when pulled up on hurdling debut (hooded).
runners.comment: Beat one home in a 1m AW maiden and was 300-1 when pulled up on hurdling debut (hooded)

races.race_name: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div I)

runners.name: American Empire
runners.spotlight: Kept on for third of 13 in Hereford maiden (2m, good) in April but safely held when filling same position in two subsequent handicaps (both 2m, good) and needs improvement here.
runners.comment: Safely held when third in first two handicaps; improvement required

runners.name: Auntie Maggie
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who won three times (once over C&D) last spring; pulled up over fences at Worcester last month but her second there in May was a fairly good effort and she reverts to hurdling on a workable mark.
runners.comment: Three wins in spring 2025; second in a chase in May; back hurdling on workable mark

runners.name: Iolaos Du Mou
runners.spotlight: Just held on to make all off 3lb lower at Warwick (2m, good) last May but, following a layoff, has dropped out quite tamely once headed here on both starts this season.
runners.comment: Front-runner; dropped out quite tamely once headed here on both starts this season

runners.name: Alshadhian
runners.spotlight: Not seen over hurdles since 65l defeat on handicap debut in April 2025 but pretty consistent over fences since; reverts to this code with trip/ground suitable; might be the answer.
runners.comment: Well beaten on handicap hurdle debut in spring 2025 but consistent over fences since
runners.owner: G C Myddelton & V E C Taylor

runners.name: Versatile
runners.spotlight: Has modest strike-rate on the Flat and is 0-4 over hurdles; placed off today's mark on handicap hurdle debut at Southwell (2m, good) last month but subsequent run in Worcester maiden was underwhelming; others have more persuasive profiles.
runners.comment: Placed on handicap hurdle debut but safely held in a subsequent maiden; others preferred

runners.name: Chicago Storm
runners.spotlight: Had jumping issues and struggled in Hexham chase on last month's stable debut; now 5lb lower than when placed over hurdles at Stratford (2m2f, good) on final start for Daisy Hitchins but still has something to prove.
runners.comment: Placed off 5lb higher on latest hurdle start but struggled in a chase on stable debut

runners.name: Ashdown Forest
runners.spotlight: Only sixth when favourite for handicap hurdle debut at Wetherby (2m, good to soft) in March and signed off for Jedd O'Keeffe with a poor Flat run in May but joined Dan Skelton for £21,000 soon afterwards and was quickly given a wind op; interesting to see what new trainer can do with him.
runners.comment: Bought for £21,000 and given wind op after poor Flat run in May; unexposed over hurdles

runners.name: Littletown Lad
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all seven hurdling starts but was prominent in the betting for all four handicaps and held third place before last-flight unseat over C&D (good) nine days ago; may yet have a bigger run in him.
runners.comment: 0-7 over hurdles but held third place before last-flight unseat over C&D nine days ago

runners.name: Captain Connor
runners.spotlight: Weakened out of contention on handicap debut at Market Rasen (about 2m6f, good) 19 days ago but that was his first run since February and positives can be taken from it; not out of this if suited by the drop back in trip; cheekpieces removed after one use.
runners.comment: Weakened on handicap debut (2m6f) but may benefit from this drop back in trip

runners.name: Colinski
runners.spotlight: Low-grade Flat winner for another stable last year; still unexposed over hurdles and wasn't given a hard time when fifth of 12 over C&D (good; beaten about 21l) on recent handicap debut, having almost lost his jockey when stumbling on the home turn.
runners.comment: Had excuses when fifth of 12 over C&D on handicap debut and remains unexposed over hurdles

runners.name: Harry Gulliver
runners.spotlight: Managed a win off lowly mark at Huntingdon (2m3f, good) in October 2024 but absent since heavy defeat the following month (albeit on slower-than-ideal ground) and might need this outing.
runners.comment: Won in October 2024 but absent since heavy defeat the following month

races.race_name: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div II)

runners.name: Thickthorn Tom
runners.spotlight: Cut little ice over hurdles last season; vastly improved over fences this summer and readily gained a third win in his last four starts in 2m4f Worcester handicap eight days ago; reverts to this sphere now off a potentially lenient mark; big shout.
runners.comment: Readily gained third chasing win at Worcester eight days ago; big shout back over hurdles

runners.name: Ocean Heights
runners.spotlight: A fair 1m4f Flat winner; quite lightly raced in this sphere and he came in a well-held third of four in 2m3f handicap at Stratford last month; needs to take a step forward.
runners.comment: A fair 1m4f Flat winner; well-held third of four at Stratford last month; more needed

runners.name: Mayday Games
runners.spotlight: Off eight months and much improved for his new yard with an easy first success in 2m handicap hurdle at Stratford last month; up 7lb but not taken lightly.
runners.comment: Much improved for new yard with easy first win at Stratford; up 7lb but not taken lightly

runners.name: Cawthorne Banker
runners.spotlight: Resumed winning ways (in a change of headgear) in C&D handicap 17 days ago; he's not always proved the most reliable so needs to back it up now from a 5lb higher mark.
runners.comment: Recent C&D winner; not the most reliable so needs to back it up now from a 5lb higher mark

runners.name: Castle Quarter
runners.spotlight: Gained a first hurdling success over C&D last May but his more recent form is far less encouraging, a well-held fifth in 2m Worcester handicap 23 days ago; others appeal more.
runners.comment: Gained a first hurdling win over C&D last May but more recent form is far less encouraging
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs R Newiss & Gavin Teversham

runners.name: Genbu
runners.spotlight: Scored over C&D in May and has continued in good nick, fifth of ten over C&D 17 days ago; not out of things off a 2lb lower mark.
runners.comment: Scored over C&D in May and has continued in good nick; not out of things eased 2lb

runners.name: Fond Farewell
runners.spotlight: Modest ex-Irish 1m3f Flat winner; yet to offer much over hurdles and fences for current yard, behind when unseating rider at the seventh fence in 2m handicap chase here 17 days ago; much more is required back in this sphere.
runners.comment: Yet to offer much over hurdles and fences for current yard; more required back hurdling

runners.name: Belcamo
runners.spotlight: Fair 1m4f Flat scorer who gained a first win in this sphere at Fakenham (2m) in January; faded from last flight when sixth of nine in 2m Worcester handicap on his return 23 days ago and should strip sharper here.
runners.comment: Won at Fakenham in January; fading sixth at Worcester 23 days ago; should strip sharper

runners.name: Jet Patrol
runners.spotlight: A two-time 2m hurdles winner but ended last season on a low note; better signs on return with fourth of nine in 2m Worcester handicap 23 days ago; needs considering.
runners.comment: Better signs on return with fourth in 2m Worcester handicap 23 days ago; considered

runners.name: Four Decades
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced mare who took a step forward on her handicap debut with fourth of five at Fakenham (2m7f) in April; drops markedly back in trip here after a break.
runners.comment: Step forward with fourth at Fakenham; drops markedly back in trip here after a break

races.race_name: Craig Reid Retirement Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Queens Wish
runners.spotlight: Ran quite well when second of four behind a next-time-out winner over C&D (good) last month and her subsequent run is best overlooked (pulled up; jockey presumably felt something was amiss) but she's too inconsistent to rely upon heavily.
runners.comment: Ran quite well over C&D two starts ago but is too inconsistent to rely upon heavily

runners.name: Jongleur d'Etoiles
runners.spotlight: Returned from 12-week break with poor run last month and is now 0-7 over fences but was close second off this mark to a dual subsequent winner at Doncaster (3m2f, good to soft) in March; player if back on song.
runners.comment: Ran poorly last month, after break, but has claims if judged on Doncaster second in March

runners.name: Slaney Opera
runners.spotlight: Seemed to run well when second of three in tactical race at Cartmel (3m1f, good) on Monday and remains 2lb lower than when winning for another stable in January but others appeal more all the same.
runners.comment: Seemed to run well in three-runner race on Monday but others appeal more all the same

runners.name: Izzy's Grey
runners.spotlight: 0-16 over hurdles but ran big race in defeat over C&D (good) on chasing debut six weeks ago and has obvious claims if able to replicate that performance.
runners.comment: 0-16 over hurdles but ran big race in defeat over C&D on chasing debut in June

runners.name: Jack's A Legend
runners.spotlight: Perhaps unlucky not to finish closer than third on stable debut at Newton Abbot (2m5f, good to soft) in April, having made a jumping error two out, but two lesser efforts have followed; first attempt at 3m under rules; needs to up his game.
runners.comment: Ran well on stable debut in April but two lesser efforts have followed; upped in trip

runners.name: Of Corse I Can
runners.spotlight: Won two modest 3m2f chases in the autumn (good/good to soft) and returned from break with encouraging run at Cartmel (2m5f, good) in May but others in this line-up look a bit stronger; 1lb wrong.
runners.comment: Won two modest 3m2f chases in October but others in this field look stronger

runners.name: Betty's Tiara
runners.spotlight: Won maiden hurdle here (2m7f, good) in September but has lost her way since, and was tailed off on recent chasing debut; might be aided by the refitted tongue-tie but it takes a big leap of faith to support her.
runners.comment: Has lost her way since course hurdle win in September; tailed off on recent chase debut

runners.name: Jo Arengeot Bey AA
runners.spotlight: Came good under rules at 12th attempt with C&D success (good; clear second won next time out) in May but was pulled up when back here last month; had another wind op (his second) soon afterwards and is now tongue tied; not an easy one to predict.
runners.comment: C&D winner in May but pulled up here since; given another wind op; hard to predict

runners.name: Uncle Al
runners.spotlight: Bounced back to form to cause 14-1 surprise in four-runner chase at Huntingdon (2m7f, good to firm) in May and is still on a workable mark after 2lb nudge but it's hard to predict whether he'll be in the right mood again.
runners.comment: Surprise winner of four-runner chase in May; claims if in right mood again here

runners.name: Jullou De Grissay
runners.spotlight: Generally disappointing since last summer's 2m7f hurdle win for a different stable but took big step back in right direction and ran well for a long way when third over fences at Worcester (2m4f, good) last month; back up in trip here; a possible.
runners.comment: Took big step back in right direction and ran well for a long way when third at Worcester
runners.owner: The Galloping Dentist At 45 The Green

runners.name: Kenzo Des Bruyeres
runners.spotlight: Dual Irish point winner; launched chasing career with two underwhelming runs this spring (3m/3m2f) and is now 0-5 under rules but can't be written off just yet.
runners.comment: Launched chase career with two underwhelming runs but not written off just yet

runners.name: Normofthenorth
runners.spotlight: Lacked fluency and was well beaten when back under rules at Stratford (2m6f, good to firm) last month but has good strike-rate in points (10-22) and can't be ruled out off current handicap mark.
runners.comment: Prolific pointer; well beaten when back under rules last month but still considered

runners.name: Miami Jim
runners.spotlight: 0-13 under all codes and absent since struggling in heavy-ground C&D contest in December (first-time cheekpieces); might be happier on this quicker surface but still makes only limited appeal from 5lb out of the weights.
runners.comment: 0-13 under all codes and makes very limited appeal from out of the weights

runners.name: Collingham
runners.spotlight: Mostly out of form since joining current stable just over a year ago and was pulled up when upped to 2m7f for Bangor hurdle race last month, after a layoff; reverts to chasing in first-time visor; has too much to prove.
runners.comment: Pulled up when upped to 2m7f over hurdles in June; reverts to chasing with lots to prove

races.race_name: Eaton Hall Shooting Ground Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Prince De Juilley
runners.spotlight: In good form in the autumn, most notably when winning in first-time visor at Stratford (2m6f, good), but failed to build upon a satisfactory reappearance run when well beaten back at Stratford last month (wore cheekpieces); goes without headgear here; has a point to prove.
runners.comment: In good form in the autumn but comes here after a disappointing effort; has point to prove

runners.name: Orange Diamond
runners.spotlight: Battled well to hold on over C&D (good) last month and is now 5-10 since joining current stable just over a year ago; up another 5lb but a likely contender again.
runners.comment: Battled well to hold on over C&D (good) last month and is now 5-10 for current stable

runners.name: Mistral Blue
runners.spotlight: Has worked her way back to peak form, following a break, and scored by just over 4l over C&D (good) six weeks ago; 5lb higher now but ought to make her presence felt again.
runners.comment: Up 5lb for C&D win six weeks ago but ought to make her presence felt again

runners.name: Kom Tu Voudras
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage mare with 2-4 strike-rate for current stable, the latter win gained in first-time cheekpieces at Worcester (2m4f, good) last month; disappointed here on latest outing but could have untapped potential over this new trip if quickly back in the groove.
runners.comment: Disappointed last time but won two starts ago (2m4f); tries a new trip today

runners.name: Colegram
runners.spotlight: Dual Irish point winner who built upon her promising rules debut when winning a Bangor maiden hurdle (2m3f, good) last month; has a lot more on her plate in this handicap but has obvious scope for further progress over the longer trip; commands respect.
runners.comment: Dual point winner; won 2m3f maiden on second rules start; should have lots more to offer

runners.name: Baltray
runners.spotlight: Just 1-12 over hurdles but ran quite well when third at Newton Abbot in May and was in contention for a place before last-flight error cooked his goose at Warwick (also 3m2f, good) last month; could have a say.
runners.comment: Just 1-22 over hurdles but comes here after two pretty good efforts over 3m2f

runners.name: Rock Hurley
runners.spotlight: Gained both British wins at Bangor, latterly when making all (2m7f, good) four weeks ago; remains unexposed over this sort of trip and is probably still on a workable mark after recent 4lb rise; high on the list.
runners.comment: Made all at Bangor (2m7f) last month and remains unexposed over this sort of trip

runners.name: Lady Caro
runners.spotlight: Ended last season in career-best form, winning easily at Taunton (3m, good) before finishing third over same C&D off new mark; probably needs to find more again on this first run for three months, though.
runners.comment: Ended last season in career-best form at Taunton; bit more needed on first run for 93 days

runners.name: Victoria Milano
runners.spotlight: Suggested her turn might be near again when second at Bangor (2m7f, good) in May but Cartmel last month was a backward step and she's now 0-6 for current stable; cheekpieces (worn once last year) tried again.
runners.comment: Placed at Bangor in May but last month's run was a backward step; cheekpieces refitted

runners.name: Belladinotte
runners.spotlight: Came from off the pace to win C&D mares' race (good) nine days ago and is now 3-17 over hurdles; due only a 3lb rise for that and faces tough task under 7lb penalty instead, but at least we know she's in good nick.
runners.comment: Won recent C&D mares' race; faces tougher task under 7lb penalty (due only a 3lb rise)

runners.name: Catuaba
runners.spotlight: In good form when last seen in autumn 2024 and will be suited by today's trip/ground but he is entitled to benefit from this outing.
runners.comment: In good form when last in action but that was back in autumn 2024
runners.owner: A C Bound & Mrs C J Djivanovic

runners.name: Dr Seb
runners.spotlight: Won this for Olly Murphy in 2024; returned from long absence with two lesser efforts towards end of last season but ran well for a long way when fifth in higher-grade C&D (good) contest for new stable this month; considered.
runners.comment: Ran well for a long way when fifth in higher-grade C&D contest on recent stable debut

runners.name: Bannister
runners.spotlight: Regressive 9yo who has modest strike-rate in recent years and made a low-key reappearance this month (2m4f); tries a new trip here; not the percentage call.
runners.comment: Regressive 9yo who has modest strike-rate in recent years; not the percentage call

runners.name: Seeitoldya
runners.spotlight: Safely held in 2m4f chase here last month and now 0-9 under rules; back up in trip and fitted with tongue-tie for this return to hurdling; considered only if lively in the betting.
runners.comment: Safely held over fences here last month and now 0-9 under rules

runners.name: Torrent
runners.spotlight: Posted three respectable efforts at around 2m4f this spring and continues to edge down the weights, but he is not bred to benefit from this step up in trip and others in this field have more interesting profiles.
runners.comment: Posted three respectable efforts at around 2m4f this spring but has stamina to prove here

runners.name: Billy Boi Blue
runners.spotlight: Has some useful form on his CV but has become very disappointing this year, usually weakening quickly; had wind op before penultimate run but it didn't appear to make much difference; others look much safer.
runners.comment: Has become very disappointing this year, usually weakening quickly

races.race_name: Louise Hall Hen Party Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Dream's Ka
runners.spotlight: On the up since sent handicapping and he gained a second success in his last three starts over C&D last month, edging out Gardener; up another 5lb but merits serious consideration.
runners.comment: On the up, scoring over C&D latest; up another 5lb but merits serious consideration

runners.name: Crystal Glance
runners.spotlight: Six months off before a win at Bangor (2m4f) in May and still going well when she fell four out in another 2m4f handicap there four weeks ago; this course winner must enter calculations in refitted cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Still going well when fell 4 out at Bangor latest; this course winner enters calculations

runners.name: Dream Diamond
runners.spotlight: Gained a first hurdling win on yard debut at Worcester (2m) last August; back in good form of late, third of six in 2m4f handicap there two weeks ago; not out of things.
runners.comment: Good third of six in 2m4f handicap there two weeks ago; not out of things

runners.name: Jammy Jay
runners.spotlight: Yet to get her head in front but she returned from six months off with a very good second of ten in 2m handicap here 17 days ago; she's proven over this longer trip and well in the mix nudged up 2lb.
runners.comment: Very good second here 17 days ago; proven over this trip and well in the mix up 2lb

runners.name: Pike Road
runners.spotlight: Posted a very good second in 2m7f Worcester handicap hurdle in June; well-held seventh retried over fences there since and it would be no surprise to see him bounce back reverting to this sphere in a change of headgear.
runners.comment: Very good Worcester second; well-held seventh over fences there since but can bounce back

runners.name: Maghlaak
runners.spotlight: Made a winning start for current yard over fences at Southwell (2m4f) in November but only eighth back hurdling in 2m7f handicap here 17 days ago; visor and tongue-tie are retried now.
runners.comment: Only eighth back hurdling here 17 days ago; visor and tongue-tie are retried now

runners.name: Gardener
runners.spotlight: Bagged a pair of 2m4f Hexham wins in the spring and comes here on the back of a good second of seven to Dream's Ka over C&D last month; enjoys a 2lb weights pull here, so very much one to consider.
runners.comment: Good second of seven to Dream's Ka over C&D last month; needs considering
runners.owner: Mrs J M Plummer & M E Sowersby

runners.name: Divilabother
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden; thriving for Tristan Davidson and bids for a hat-trick following handicap wins at Hexham (2m7f) and Cartmel (2m6f) last month, getting up late each time; up another 5lb but this likeable sort is a player once more.
runners.comment: On hat-trick after wins at Hexham and Cartmel; up another 5lb but he's a player again

runners.name: Magical Hill
runners.spotlight: Landed novices at Huntingdon and Kelso in spring 2024 for Patrick Neville but off since posting a solid sixth in 2m5f handicap at Market Rasen over two years ago; the market can guide on this comeback run for new yard.
runners.comment: Off since solid sixth at Market Rasen over two years ago; the market can guide on comeback

runners.name: Wudya
runners.spotlight: Made a winning start for current yard over hurdles at Bangor (2m4f) last July; has failed to build on it though, coming in a remote fourth in 2m5f handicap chase at Market Rasen last month; has it to prove back in this sphere.
runners.comment: Remote fourth over fences at Market Rasen last month; has it to prove back in this sphere

runners.name: Golden Maverick
runners.spotlight: A three-time hurdles winner (around 2m) for Jamie Snowden but signed off for him with a below-par fifth in 2m6f Cartmel handicap 14 months ago; needs to hit the ground running for his new handler.
runners.comment: Off 14 months since a below-par fifth at Cartmel; needs to hit ground running for new yard

races.race_name: Eleven Eleven Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Ice Jet
runners.spotlight: Vastly improved this summer (after wind surgery) and completed a quick hat-trick over hurdles at Worcester (2m4f) in May; shaped very well on his chasing debut with short-head second of eight in 2m4f handicap here 17 days ago; hiked up 11lb but can regain winning ways.
runners.comment: Shaped very well with short-head second here on chasing debut; can go one better here

runners.name: Schmilsson
runners.spotlight: A dual 2m chase winner at Perth last summer; off 11 months but not discredited with second of four in 2m handicap chase at Newton Abbot three weeks ago; considered off same mark.
runners.comment: Off 11 months but not discredited with second at Newton Abbot; considered off same mark
runners.owner: Both Sides Of The Sea Syndicate

runners.name: Ghasham
runners.spotlight: Ended a losing run for his new yard in 2m handicap chase at Hexham in June and backed it up with a solid third of seven at Cartmel (2m1f) 26 days ago; in the mix again.
runners.comment: Won at Hexham before solid third of seven at Cartmel 26 days ago; in the mix again.

runners.name: Rocks Up Late
runners.spotlight: Back from six months off with success in 2m1f handicap chase at Stratford (2m1f) in May; only seventh of ten in 2m handicap hurdle here 17 days ago but no surprise to see him bounce back reverting to this sphere.
runners.comment: Won at Stratford in May; only seventh here latest; can bounce back reverting to fences

runners.name: Gaelic Rambler
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 6yo who comes here on the back of a good third of eight (Ice Jet runner-up) in 2m4f handicap chase here 17 days ago; not out of things in his bid for a maiden success.
runners.comment: Good third here 17 days ago; not out of things in his bid for a maiden success

runners.name: Seeyouinmydreams
runners.spotlight: Ended time with Paul Nicholls with 2m Hexham selling hurdles success in May; well held both runs for new yard back chasing, only fifth of seven at Stratford (2m1f) last month; others appeal more.
runners.comment: Well held both runs for new yard back chasing; others appeal more

runners.name: Merely A Detail
runners.spotlight: Winless over hurdles but she made a successful chasing debut in 2m Worcester handicap 23 days ago; up 5lb but not taken lightly.
runners.comment: Won chase debut in 2m Worcester handicap 23 days ago; up 5lb but not taken lightly

runners.name: Duke Of Luckley
runners.spotlight: Dictated pace when scoring at Southwell (2m) in June but came in a well-held third of four off 9lb higher mark in 2m handicap chase at Newton Abbot three weeks ago; needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Won at Southwell but well-held third at Newton Abbot since; needs to bounce back

runners.name: Dog Fox
runners.spotlight: Making a promising start in this sphere (close up) when he unseated rider two out in 2m1f Kelso handicap last September; failed to build on it twice subsequently but back in good form over hurdles of late, so not ruled out.
runners.comment: Failed to build on promising Kelso chasing debut; in good form hurdling, so not ruled out
runners.owner: The North West National Hunt Racing Club

races.race_name: QuinnBet Mares' Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Sparkling Water
runners.spotlight: Failed to complete all three Irish points in spring 2025 but made the frame in two slow-ground bumpers for Ralph Beckett in early part of this year, despite racing too freely; subsequently changed hands for £12,000; major player if coping with this quicker surface on debut for Dan Skelton.
runners.comment: Made the frame twice on slow ground at start of this year; now with Dan Skelton

runners.name: Thetype Istitle
runners.spotlight: Delivered on promise shown in Irish points when making all in a conditional/amateurs' bumper at Stratford (good to firm) last month; escapes a penalty for that and features prominently in calculations.
runners.comment: Made all on last month's rules debut at Stratford and escapes a penalty for that

runners.name: Upton Fern
runners.spotlight: Closely related to useful 2m7f hurdle winner Doc Penfro; not beaten far when fifth of seven behind Thetype Istitle at Stratford (good to firm) last month but needs to build on that performance; tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Not beaten far when fifth behind Thetype Istitle at Stratford but needs to improve

runners.name: Mouth Watering
runners.spotlight: Fifth foal; half-sister to a French/Spanish Flat winner; dam French 1m4f winner, half-sister to a Listed Flat winner and two useful hurdlers; trainer is not known for bumper winners but has booked James Bowen (3-10 for stable) for this newcomer.
runners.comment: Out of a well-connected French Flat winner; James Bowen a good booking on debut

runners.name: Lucy Glitters
runners.spotlight: Out of a fair bumper/hurdle winner; no match for winner but kept on well for second of 14 on debut at Worcester (good; hooded, as today) six weeks ago; shortlisted.
runners.comment: No match for winner but kept on well for second of 14 at Worcester in June; shortlisted

runners.name: La Moon
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam fourth in a bumper and well held in novice hurdles, half-sister to high-class jumper Whisper and a French Listed hurdle winner; stable not that prolific in bumpers but this newcomer still looks interesting.
runners.comment: Out of a half-sister to high-class jumper Whisper; looks interesting on paper

runners.name: Ebarayna
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Ebadiyan (Flat/smart hurdle), Ensaya (Listed-placed 1m4f) and Ebasani (useful 1m-1m4f); trainer doesn't run many in bumpers; well worth a glance in the betting.
runners.comment: Out of a well-connected mare and well worth a glance in the betting

runners.name: Frankie's Flame
runners.spotlight: Out of a 7.5f Flat winner; kept on for fourth of seven (just over 5l behind Thetype Istitle) on last month's debut at Stratford but others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Kept on for fourth of seven on last month's debut at Stratford but others look stronger

runners.name: Dreaming Of The Dr
runners.spotlight: Hooded for both starts; bettered last November's low-key debut when fourth of 11 over C&D (good; against males) nine days ago and any further progress will give her each-way claims at least.
runners.comment: Bettered low-key debut when fourth over C&D last week; each-way claims at least

runners.name: Guerdale
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten on first two starts (both on good) and difficult to enthuse over.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten on first two starts (both on good) and difficult to enthuse over

runners.name: Petite Poet
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to a bumper winner; not beaten far when fifth of six at Newton Abbot (good) last month but it's not form to get that excited about.
runners.comment: Not beaten far when fifth of sixth on debut but it's not form to get that excited about

runners.name: Eagles Promise
runners.spotlight: Out of a hurdle-winning sister to smart bumper/jumps winner Super Duty and useful jumper Grandads Cottage; faded into seventh of 14 on debut at Worcester (good) six weeks ago and needs that run to have done her good.
runners.comment: Faded into seventh of 14 on debut at Worcester six weeks ago

runners.name: Georgie's Lady
runners.spotlight: Out of sister to Listed Flat/smart jumps winner Noble Prince but well held when 33-1 for debut at Hereford (good) in April; hood removed.
runners.comment: Well held when 33-1 for debut at Hereford (good) in April; hood removed

races.race_name: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Inc' Race)

runners.name: Little Lady Karen
runners.spotlight: Has shown ability in a couple of small fields, most recently when runner-up behind an odds-on rival at Beverley (7.4f, good); has looked rather headstrong so far but it's still early days and she sets the standard on this drop back in trip; one of two runners for Karl Burke.
runners.comment: Chased home an odds-on rival at Beverley latest and she sets the standard on that form

runners.name: Martinet
runners.spotlight: 40-1 at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) last week but she was always prominent and gave it a good shot before finishing a 3l fourth of 12; that was a promising start and has each-way claims if she can build on that.
runners.comment: Ran well at a big price at Wolverhampton last week and has claims if she can build on that

runners.name: Diamond New Bay
runners.spotlight: New Bay filly; closely related to winners Queen Me (Group-placed 6f 2yo; RPR 104) and Bint Queen Kindly (7f; 95), half-sister to two winners including Alia Choice (5f AW/5.4f turf; 97); dam 5f/6f winner (including 2yo Group 2; 112), out of 6f Group 2 winner; lots to like on paper and she's an interesting newcomer.
runners.comment: New Bay filly who has a striking pedigree and needs a close look on debut

runners.name: Isabella De Vega
runners.spotlight: 350,000gns yearling; sister to five winners including Expensive Queen (US 1m/8.5f inc Grade 1; RPR 116), Antonia De Vega (7f-1m4f including 2yo/Group 3; 112) and Al Haarith (1m; 96); dam Listed-placed 7f winner (100), half-sister to 1m Group 1 winner Al Wukair; has a striking pedigree and she needs a close look on debut.
runners.comment: Cost 350,000gns as a yearling and is a sister to a Grade 1 winner; interesting newcomer

runners.name: Diplomata
runners.spotlight: 140,000euros yearling; didn't live up to market expectations at Yarmouth (6f, good to soft) in May but she ran green before making some late headway; that debut form is modest but she should know more this time and it wouldn't be a surprise if she took a major step forward upped in trip.
runners.comment: Disappointing on Yarmouth debut but it wouldn't be a surprise if she left that form behind

runners.name: Love Tanya
runners.spotlight: 110,000euros yearling by Blue Point; weak 15-2 shot at Carlisle (6f, good to firm) last month and she got outpaced before finishing a remote third of five; should be more streetwise this time but she needs a transformation upped in trip.
runners.comment: Remote third on Carlisle debut and she needs a transformation upped in trip

runners.name: Skyglow
runners.spotlight: 50-1 and she faded into a well-held fourth of five at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago; that form is well below the standard here and she could be more of a handicap prospect.
runners.comment: Finished fourth of five at Yarmouth and she could be more of a handicap prospect

races.race_name: Sky Bet For The Fans EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Statten Island
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to four winners including Raaeb (5f-7f including 2yo; RPR 108); disappointing when 6-4 at Ayr last time but the soft ground may have held him back and he showed plenty of promise on his York debut (fourth of 15) in May; just about sets the standard on that form and and he's a big player if he can bounce back.
runners.comment: Showed plenty of promise at York and he had an excuse on soft ground last time; respected

runners.name: Roman Crystal
runners.spotlight: Has improved with each of her three runs but she was still beaten around 5l when fourth of eight at York (6f, good to firm; 50-1) last time; needs another major step forward here and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Has shown ability but she needs another major step forward here

runners.name: Blessed Voyager
runners.spotlight: 80,000euros yearling; second foal out of a 5.7f-1m winner (including 2yo Group 3; RPR 106); 11-1 on Newbury debut in April but he led 1f out before keeping on well to beat a clear second; gelded since but that was a bright start and he's open to progress on this step up in trip; respected under a penalty.
runners.comment: Won on Newbury debut in April and he's strongly respected under a penalty; now gelded

runners.name: Blakey Ridge
runners.spotlight: 105,000euros yearling; by Sioux Nation out of unraced half-sister to 6f Group 1 winner Emaraaty Ana; weak 14-1 shot at Carlisle (good to soft) last month but he finished a promising third from a wide draw; should know more this time and he's a likely improver upped in trip.
runners.comment: Promising third at Carlisle and he's a likely improver on this step up in trip

runners.name: Meccapulco
runners.spotlight: 37,000euros yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to 7f/1m AW 2yo winner Irrelevant (RPR 65); dam lightly raced maiden (66), closely related to 9.4f Group 3 winner Jack Naylor, out 1m2f Listed winner; yard 19% with 2yos this season and she needs checking in market on debut.
runners.comment: Yard 19% with 2yos this season and she needs checking in market on debut

runners.name: Dodgem
runners.spotlight: 50,000gns yearling; second foal; dam French 1m winner, sister to 1m4f winner Blowing Dixie, half-sister to winners Cursory Glance (7f 2yo Group 1) and Sweet Memories (1m4f Listed), out of 1m2f winning sister to 1m4f Group 2 winner Time On; has good standard to aim at on debut and he could be a longer-term prospect.
runners.comment: Well-bred colt but he could be one for longer trips further down the line

runners.name: Naughty At Forty
runners.spotlight: £28,000 yearling; sister to winners Scarlet Bear (Group-placed 6f; RPR 98), Elinor Dashwood (6f 2yo/7f; 92) and Spring (6f 2yo; 63); dam placed 7f AW (60), out of 6f 2yo/7f Group 3 winning half-sister to useful 7f-1m winner Bronze Prince; this looks a tough starting point and yard is 0-5 with 2yos this year.
runners.comment: This looks a tough starting point and yard is 0-5 with 2yos this year

runners.name: Spruce
runners.spotlight: 25-1 and he finished tailed off in a Salisbury maiden (7f, good to firm) for Martyn Meade last month; best watched on stable debut.
runners.comment: Tailed off in a Salisbury maiden for Martyn Meade last month; best watched for new yard

runners.name: Trust In Far
runners.spotlight: Has struggled at big prices in her three runs (6f, good to soft/good), with best RPR of 26.
runners.comment: Has struggled at big prices in her three runs (6f), with best RPR of 26

races.race_name: Ruby Lodge Care Home In Thirsk Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Liveadream
runners.spotlight: Has improved with each of her three runs and she went very close in a Musselburgh seller (7f, good) last month; now switches to a nursery but that was bold bid last time and she's respected on this drop back in trip.
runners.comment: Had a near-miss in a seller last time and she's respected back in trip on nursery debut
runners.owner: Nick Bradley Racing 13 & P J Makin

runners.name: Lady Dublin
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the fifth attempt when making all for an emphatic win on nursery debut at Catterick (6f, good to firm; cheekpieces added) last week; this is a much deeper race but she was never in any danger last time and looks well treated under a penalty; key player.
runners.comment: Easy win on nursery debut at Catterick last week and she looks well treated under penalty

runners.name: Eevee Star
runners.spotlight: Promising third on Ripon debut (6f, good) in May but she's been disappointing in both subsequent runs; still early days but she needs a transformation back up in trip on nursery debut.
runners.comment: Regressive form in novice events and has something to prove on nursery debut

runners.name: Inns And Out
runners.spotlight: Well held in a Newcastle maiden (7f, AW) last month but that may have come too soon after his promising third over 6f at Ripon (good); looks interesting on that form and he's in the mix back in trip on nursery debut.
runners.comment: His best effort was a third at Ripon (6f) on penultimate run; in the mix on nursery debut

runners.name: Crystal Kraken
runners.spotlight: Hasn't threatened in her four starts but she's only been beaten around 3l in last two runs (6f, good/AW) and her RPRs have been progressive; looks on fair mark now switched to a nursery and she should get a good tow into this race; dangerous.
runners.comment: Her RPRs have been progressive in four starts and she's in the mix on nursery debut

runners.name: Lairy Mary
runners.spotlight: Her form has been up and down so far but she won a Beverley claimer (5f, good to firm) in May and was a close fourth in a Catterick nursery two weeks ago; looks worth a try at this new trip and she's in the mix off same mark as last time.
runners.comment: Close fourth in a Catterick nursery (5f) latest and she's in the mix at this new trip

runners.name: Spirit Of Mary
runners.spotlight: Got closer to the target on nursery debut when third of eighth at Pontefract (6f, good) two weeks ago; rallied well in the closing stages of that race and she's a player if she can find some extra spark.
runners.comment: Good third on nursery debut at Pontefract and she's a player if she can build on that

runners.name: Claret And Blues
runners.spotlight: Has plenty of speed in his good pedigree but he's not progressed so far and was beaten 6l on nursery debut at Pontefract (6f, good) two weeks ago; still early days but he needs to significantly raise his game.
runners.comment: No progress so far and was beaten 6l on nursery debut at Pontefract (6f, good)

runners.name: Enemy Action
runners.spotlight: Well held in his three runs so far, most recently when a 6l third in a Beverley maiden (5f, good to firm) three weeks ago; still unexposed and now goes handicapping but he needs improvement back up in trip.
runners.comment: Well held in three qualifying runs and he needs improvement on nursery debut

runners.name: Mardy Bum
runners.spotlight: Good third on nursery debut at Catterick (5f, good to firm) 16 days ago but she finished 8l behind Lady Dublin over C&D (third of four) last week; has bit to prove again after that and she's now 0-5.
runners.comment: Five-race maiden who was beaten 8l in C&D nursery last week; others preferred

runners.name: Trust Havana
runners.spotlight: Big prices and she finished ahead of just two rivals in three maiden/novice events at Chester (6f); still early days but slow starts have been an issue so far and she needs a transformation on nursery debut.
runners.comment: Hasn't shown much in three runs at Chester and needs lots of improvement on nursery debut

runners.name: Bea Kindly
runners.spotlight: Well held in three runs at 5f, with a best RPR of 40; half-sister to a 6f winner but she needs plenty of improvement upped in trip on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Well held in three 5f runs and she needs plenty of improvement on handicap debut

races.race_name: Graham Lee Injured Jockeys' Fund Donate Today Handicap

runners.name: Tupero
runners.spotlight: Progressive 4yo who made it 2-5 on turf when completing a double at Nottingham (1m6f, good) in May; 4lb higher after a short break but he remains feasibly treated and is still unexposed at staying trips; key player.
runners.comment: Made it 2-5 on turf when completing a double at Nottingham in May; big player again up 4lb

runners.name: Gaelic Approach
runners.spotlight: Won handicaps at Leicester (1m4f, good) and Redcar (1m6f, good to firm) in the spring but he's failed to beat a rival in last two starts; bit to prove but he got shuffled back in a tactical race at Chester last time and has possibilities if he can bounce back.
runners.comment: Two wins in the spring and has claims if he can get back near his best
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing Xxiii & M Hulin

runners.name: Twilight Safari
runners.spotlight: Still a maiden after 12 starts and was last of four in a Doncaster handicap (14.5f, good to firm) two weeks ago; wasn't beaten far in that race but he needs to find more to get off the mark.
runners.comment: 12-race maiden who was last of four in a handicap at Doncaster (14.5f) last time

runners.name: Gibside
runners.spotlight: Eight wins at up to 2m2f and he's versatile ground-wise; his last success was off 5lb higher at Catterick (1m4f) last autumn but he's been out of sorts this season and was tailed off at York last time; now drops back in grade but he needs a major revival.
runners.comment: Eight-time winner who is on a dangerous mark but he's been out of sorts this season

runners.name: Port George
runners.spotlight: 50-1 second in a Windsor maiden (11.4f, good) last May but he was tailed off in his final two runs (novice/handicap) last season; still unexposed but he's untried at this trip; non-runner when due to make his reappearance at Newbury (8.15) on Thursday.
runners.comment: Tailed off in final two runs last season; non-runner in the 8.15 at Newbury on Thursday

races.race_name: NRFC Leading Roof Excellence Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Miss Rainbow
runners.spotlight: Won this race last year and she scored over 5f here (good) last month; can be a bit up and down but she's finished a creditable third in last two runs, including at Catterick (6f, good to firm) on Wednesday; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Won this race last year and creditable third at Catterick on Wednesday; shortlisted

runners.name: Celtic Arrow
runners.spotlight: Reached the frame in three maidens at Newcastle in the spring and she started her handicap career with a close call over C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago; only 1lb higher here and this lightly raced filly is an interesting contender.
runners.comment: Lightly raced filly who had a close call on handicap debut over C&D; respected

runners.name: Zooella
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who returned after 207 days off with a dominant display in a Lingfield handicap (6f, AW) last Monday; 3lb well in under a penalty for that success and she's open to more progress on this switch to turf; strong contender.
runners.comment: Unexposed 3yo who reappeared with an easy win at Lingfield; 3lb well in under a penalty

runners.name: Taygar
runners.spotlight: All four wins have been on good or slower ground but she's been knocking on the door in her last five runs including when runner-up on good to firm at Ayr last time; on unchanged mark and she should be in the thick of things again.
runners.comment: 5yo who has been knocking on the door in her last five runs; respected

runners.name: Love Alive
runners.spotlight: Won at Wolverhampton (5f, AW) in February but she's not gone on from that and has been well held in her last four runs; continues to drop down the weights but she has plenty to prove back up in trip for another new yard.
runners.comment: Has been disappointing since her AW win in February; plenty to prove for another new yard

runners.name: Canaria Queen
runners.spotlight: Recorded her eighth turf win when scoring at Hamilton (5f, good to soft) last month but she's been well held in both subsequent runs; has bit to prove again and she's never won over this trip.
runners.comment: Eight-time turf winner but all at shorter trips and she's been well held in last two runs

runners.name: Ziggy's Queen
runners.spotlight: Last-gasp winner on AW at Lingfield (7f) in February but she's struggled since and was last of six at Catterick two weeks ago; that took her turf record to 1-23 and she has plenty to prove back at this trip.
runners.comment: Won on AW in February but she's struggled since and her turf record is now 1-23

runners.name: Oasis Cover
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden; runner-up at Redcar (6f, good) in June but she's been hard to predict so far and was beaten 16l on her stable debut at Ripon last week; comes with risks attached and others are more convincing.
runners.comment: Seven-race maiden who was tailed off on her stable debut at Ripon last week

runners.name: Eartha
runners.spotlight: Won a Wetherby maiden (5.5f, good) in June 2024 but she's been lightly raced since and has struggled in her last four runs; mark is tumbling but she needs a major revival on her second run after a year off; cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: On reduced mark but she needs a major revival on her second run after a year off

races.race_name: JW4X4 Northallerton Handicap

runners.name: Dubai Venture
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 5yo who made it 3-6 in 1m4f handicaps when justifying favouritism at Pontefract (1m4f, good) two weeks ago; up 4lb but that was a comfortable success and he's open to more progress at this trip; key player.
runners.comment: Made it 3-6 in 1m4f handicaps when justifying favouritism at Pontefract; key player

runners.name: Max Of Stars
runners.spotlight: Seven-time hurdle winner who is 1-11 on the Flat; faded back over hurdles at Newton Abbot three weeks ago but she was runner-up at Ripon (1m4f, good) last month, and that was a bold bid after wind surgery; has claims on that form and she's in the mix back in this sphere.
runners.comment: Faded over hurdles latest but he was a good second at Ripon (1m4f) on his penultimate run
runners.owner: Mrs S D Pearson & Ollie Pears

runners.name: Educate
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been on Tapeta and latest was 15 months ago; respectable third at Redcar (1m6f, good) and Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) in his last two runs but this is a competitive race and others are more persuasive.
runners.comment: Fair third on turf and Tapeta in last two runs but others are more persuasive

runners.name: Wolf Of Badenoch
runners.spotlight: Just one win in his first 18 starts but he doubled his tally when coming from off the pace to score at Carlisle (1m3f, good to firm) two weeks ago; up 3lb but that was a brave win and he shaped as though this trip should be within range; respected.
runners.comment: Ended a long losing run when scoring at Carlisle (1m3f) two weeks ago; respected up 3lb

runners.name: Sixty Plus
runners.spotlight: Won four times over hurdles between July and September last year, but he lost his way in that sphere and has struggled in three Flat runs this summer; now makes his Flat handicap debut but he needs a transformation back up in trip; cheekpieces reapplied.
runners.comment: Four hurdle wins; unexposed on the Flat but he needs transformation on handicap debut

races.race_name: Racing Excellence Apprentice Handicap (Apprentice Training Race - Racing Excellence Series)

runners.name: Sunlit Sea
runners.spotlight: 0-8 on AW but she made it second-time lucky on turf when scoring by 6l at Lingfield (5f, good to firm) last week; this is a deeper race but she hit a clear personal best last time and is a major player again under a penalty (due to be up 1lb in future).
runners.comment: Unexposed on turf and she won by 6l at Lingfield last week; strong claims under penalty

runners.name: Irish Dancer
runners.spotlight: Well below form at Catterick last week but he had a near-miss over C&D (good) last month and he made all when winning this race last year; has claims if he can bounce back again and he's in the mix.
runners.comment: Hard to predict but he had a near-miss here last month and he won this race last year

runners.name: Gwen Tennyson
runners.spotlight: Third in a Catterick novice (5f, good to firm) in May but that form has taken several knocks and she's failed to get competitive in three handicaps since.
runners.comment: Third in a Catterick novice in May but she's struggled in handicaps since

runners.name: So Grateful
runners.spotlight: Record of 2-40 on turf but his last win was at Thirsk last spring and he was runner-up at Beverley (5f, good to firm) last week; looks interesting off 1lb lower here and he's respected back at this track.
runners.comment: His last win was at Thirsk and he finished runner-up at Beverley last week; respected

runners.name: Midnight Lir
runners.spotlight: Some creditable efforts season including when fourth of ten over C&D (good) on his penultimate run; that form puts him in the picture but overall record is now 2-31 and his last win was in 2023.
runners.comment: Some good efforts this season but overall record is now 2-31 and his last win was in 2023

runners.name: Mare Of London
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise for George Scott last season but she's finished down the field in her three handicaps including on recent stable debut at Ripon (6f, good); may have needed that run but she's now 0-7 and others are more convincing.
runners.comment: Seven-race maiden who was beaten 8l on recent stable debut at Ripon; down the list
runners.owner: Ursa Major & Mark Walford Racing Club

runners.name: Albegone
runners.spotlight: Nine-time turf winner who is well treated on his win at Catterick last spring; has been up and down since but he's finished runner-up four times this year including at Catterick (5f, good to firm) on his penultimate run; could be dangerous in another switch of headgear.
runners.comment: On dangerous mark and was runner-up at Catterick on his penultimate run; in the mix
runners.owner: D B & Mrs C Lamplough & Partner

runners.name: Dabbling
runners.spotlight: 0-9 but she finished a respectable third off this reduced mark at Beverley (5f, good to firm) ten days ago; could go well again but she needs to find something extra to make the breakthrough.
runners.comment: Fair third at Beverley ten days ago but she needs to find more to make the breakthrough

runners.name: Country Artiste
runners.spotlight: 12-race maiden who has form figures of 556097 in handicaps and was always in rear at Beverley (5f, good to firm) last Tuesday; opposable.
runners.comment: 12-race maiden who has form figures of 556097 in handicaps; opposable

races.race_name: eventmasters.co.uk Handicap

runners.name: Golden Strike
runners.spotlight: He's done well since this visor went on and he won a big-field C&D handicap (good) in May; merely midfield here four weeks ago but the blindfold was removed late and he was stretched by 1m; in calculations back at 7f.
runners.comment: Won big-field C&D handicap in May and had excuses over 1m here subsequently

runners.name: Alpha Capture
runners.spotlight: Enjoying good campaign for new yard, winning at Doncaster (7f, good) last month and short-headed there (7f, good to firm) latest; still mileage in his mark on old form (2yo Listed win here in 2022); didn't run well in 2023 when he wore blinkers (replacing cheekpieces) but lots to like otherwise.
runners.comment: Enjoying good campaign for new yard and still mileage in his mark on old form

runners.name: Jonny Concrete
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer who has been running well in defeat over 6f this season, including here; his last win came over 7f at Musselburgh last April and he could be in the mix back up in trip.
runners.comment: Running well in defeat over 6f this season; last win came at 7f; could be in the mix

runners.name: Roaring Ralph
runners.spotlight: Made it five wins from his last six starts when scoring at Wetherby (1m, good to firm) last month; only third of six when unpenalised at Beverley (7.4f, good) eight days later but not discounted given his previous form.
runners.comment: Prolific this year; only third of six at Beverley last time but not discounted

runners.name: Jet Warrior
runners.spotlight: Won two in a row in May (6f, good to firm/good) and finished close up on final two runs for Ben Haslam (6f, good to soft); changed hands for 14,000gns recently and he should be fine back up to 7f on his stable debut; might not be far away in a first-time visor.
runners.comment: In good form for Ben Haslam prior to 14,000gns sale; visor goes on; might not be far away

runners.name: Invincible Ruby
runners.spotlight: Won at Carlisle (6f, good) last month before keeping on for third at Pontefract (6f, good) six days later, and back on the scoresheet at Carlisle (6f, good) three weeks ago; won over 7f last July; could be in the mix.
runners.comment: Two wins over Carlisle's stiff 6f from her last three starts; has won at 7f; in the mix

runners.name: Royal Accord
runners.spotlight: He's tackling a competitive handicap on this first run of the year and it's possible he'll be rusty; however, he was progressive for Stuart Williams during last season's 3yo campaign and is of interest on stable debut.
