runners.comment: Could be rusty on first run of the year but he was progressive last season; of interest

runners.name: Ashen
runners.spotlight: Won at Ayr (7f, good to firm) in May and has continued in good form, beaten a short head when second of five at Hamilton (6f, good) a fortnight ago; back up in grade today but could give another good account.
runners.comment: Won at Ayr in May and has continued in good form; could give another good account

runners.name: Stratocracy
runners.spotlight: Sixth of 22 over C&D (good) in May on reappearance and further respectable efforts when fifth of 14 on his next two starts (7f, good to firm); however, he needs something extra to return to winning ways today.
runners.comment: Running pretty well in defeat this season but needs something extra to win today
runners.owner: Total Asbestos Solutions Ltd & A Frost

runners.name: Misunderstood
runners.spotlight: 1m 2yo Group 3 winner at Longchamp in September 2024; he's nothing like the same force now but has dropped down the weights and wasn't beaten far in seventh of 17 at Ayr (6f, good) last time despite a slow start; not ruled out back up to 7f.
runners.comment: Not the force of old but has dropped down the weights and last time was encouraging

runners.name: Monsieur Bondy
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who won two 7f novices last August/September; dropping down the weights and a market check is advised but he's been down the field at Doncaster on his three starts this season (7f, good to firm).
runners.comment: Lightly raced 4yo; market check advised but struggling to get competitive this season

runners.name: Orne
runners.spotlight: He's on a long losing run and can be inconsistent, but this front-runner was third of 22 over C&D (good) in May and wasn't beaten far when seventh of 20 over C&D (good) last time; each-way possibilities from low draw.
runners.comment: On a long losing run but has run some good races over C&D this year; each-way possible

runners.name: Quest For Fun
runners.spotlight: 8yo who has displayed mixed form this season and was below par over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago, but he showed spark when third of 22 over C&D (good) two starts ago and he has an excellent record in this race, having won it in 2023 and dead-heated for first last year; respected.
runners.comment: Below par over C&D last time but has an excellent record in this race and he's respected

runners.name: Mr King
runners.spotlight: Returned to form to exploit a reduced mark at Thirsk (7f, good) last month on his third start for this yard; a modest 3lb rise has followed and he's a contender if backing up that latest performance.
runners.comment: Exploited reduced mark at Thirsk last month; contender if backing that up

runners.name: Fortamour
runners.spotlight: 10yo who went close at Ripon (6f, good) in May and stumbled at the start when an unplaced favourite there last month; however, his last eight wins have come at Ripon or Newcastle and he's 0-8 at York.
runners.comment: 10yo who went close at Ripon in May but he's a six-time winner there and is 0-8 at York

runners.name: Intervention
runners.spotlight: Fully 15lb lower than when winning at Lingfield (6f, AW) last December but this 9yo has regressed in recent months; has to turn things around.
runners.comment: His mark continues to fall but this 9yo has regressed in recent months

runners.name: Mister Sox
runners.spotlight: Third at Pontefract (6f, good) last month and another good run when second at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) next time; however, soundly beaten here (6f, good to firm) latest and he's been unplaced on his eight visits to York.
runners.comment: Some good form this summer but not here last time; unplaced on his eight visits to York

runners.name: Lord Bertie
runners.spotlight: His wins have come on slow ground and he's unraced on a fast surface, but he kept on for a respectable sixth of 17 at Ayr (6f, good) last time and could have an each-way shout if the going isn't an issue.
runners.comment: Unraced on fast ground but kept on for respectable sixth of 17 at Ayr last time (6f, good)

races.race_name: Elevator Company Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Treasure Islands
runners.spotlight: Won at Ripon (2m, good) in April and at Catterick (2m, good to firm) last month; a case can be made on those performances but he hasn't been at the top of his game on his two runs since, including over C&D last time.
runners.comment: Two wins this season but not at the top of his game on his last two runs

runners.name: Midnight Rumble
runners.spotlight: His sole win came back in June 2024 but he often runs well and was third of seven at Chester (2m, good) four weeks ago on his second stable start; might be in with an each-way shout.
runners.comment: His sole win came back in June 2024 but he often runs well; might have an each-way shout

runners.name: Vaguely Royal
runners.spotlight: Some good runs in defeat this spring at up to 2m1f and he bounced back from his Newbury flop to win at Chester (1m6f, good) a fortnight ago; he was given a good ride last time but could still be a force today up 4lb.
runners.comment: Given a good ride when winning at Chester, but could still be a force up 4lb

runners.name: Queen Roslyn
runners.spotlight: Arrives with something to prove having been well beaten here on her two starts this summer (1m2f/1m4f); however, she was progressive last July/September, winning at up to 2m, and she won over hurdles in March; possibilities if she's back on song in a first-time tongue-tie; watch the betting.
runners.comment: She's struggled here this summer but perhaps a tongue-tie will help turn things around

runners.name: Rogue Empire
runners.spotlight: Won at Lingfield (2m, good) in May on his second start of the season and has also scored with something to spare on both outings since (2m, AW/good); in a much deeper contest today but he's clearly on the up; player.
runners.comment: He's won his last three with something to spare; deeper race today but clearly on the up

runners.name: Nanny Park
runners.spotlight: Kept on for reasonable third of six at Doncaster last month on first crack at 1m4f before winning over 14.5f there a fortnight ago (good to firm each time); had just three rivals to beat last time but she's unexposed over staying trips and could be in the shake-up.
runners.comment: Had just 3 rivals to beat last time but unexposed over staying trips; could be in shake-up

runners.name: Talismans Time
runners.spotlight: Tailed off here on final run last season and pulled up at Musselburgh on reappearance, but this lightly raced 4yo got back on track when third here (1m6f, good) four weeks ago and could build on that effort; chance.
runners.comment: Back on track when third here four weeks ago and could build on that effort; chance

runners.name: Tarbat Ness
runners.spotlight: Two wins at Newcastle (2m, AW) early this year and another at Carlisle (2m1f, good) three weeks ago; this 7yo is up 5lb to a career-high mark and everything dropped right last time, but he's nevertheless entitled to respect having won in fine style.
runners.comment: Easy win at Carlisle last time; up 5lb to career-high mark but respected nevertheless

runners.name: Furhaan
runners.spotlight: He's gradually worked his way back into form for his new yard this year, finishing second over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago; one to consider.
runners.comment: He's gradually worked his way back into form and was second over C&D a fortnight ago

runners.name: Venezuelan
runners.spotlight: Edging down the weights and the return to a more galloping track could help, but his claims aren't compelling based on what he's shown at Chester this year on his three starts for a new yard.
runners.comment: The return to a more galloping track could help but his claims aren't compelling

runners.name: Trojan Sun
runners.spotlight: Won at Carlisle (1m6f, good) last month and bounced back from lesser run there (1m3f, good to firm) when third over this C&D a fortnight ago (stablemate Furhaan second); might not be far away.
runners.comment: Won at Carlisle last month and third over this C&D a fortnight ago; might not be far away

runners.name: Newport
runners.spotlight: Some good form over hurdles, including a win at Hexham (2m, good) last month; shaped when fifth in this code at Hamilton (1m3f, good) in May as though he could do with a longer trip, and he gets it today; interesting.
runners.comment: Won over hurdles last month and he could be favoured by today's step up in trip

runners.name: Valley Of Flowers
runners.spotlight: Behind a couple of these when fourth over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago but that was still a respectable run and she won at Carlisle (1m3f, good) prior to that; went close in this race in 2024; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Went close in this race in 2024 and she won at Carlisle two starts ago; not ruled out

races.race_name: Ire-Incentive, It Pays To Buy Irish EBF Restricted Novice (Bands C-D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)

runners.name: Coral Cove
runners.spotlight: Brings the strongest form into the race having finished second of 13 in a fillies' maiden at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) five weeks ago; obvious chance of going one better.
runners.comment: Good second of 13 on last month's Doncaster debut; obvious chance to go one better

runners.name: Travellers Girl
runners.spotlight: Three runs at 6f, showing her best form when third at Ripon 18 days ago; she was coming with a threatening run when getting squeezed out in the final 150 yards on that occasion and the performance can be upgraded; worth a crack at 7f; should go well.
runners.comment: Promise in 6f events, notably at Ripon 18 days ago; 7f worth exploring; should go well

runners.name: The First Drop
runners.spotlight: 25-1 for his debut at Carlisle (7f, good to firm) last month but he made an encouraging start, finishing second of the 11 runners; improvement will be needed to win but it's certainly not out of the question.
runners.comment: Good start to his career when second at Carlisle last month; each-way shout again

runners.name: Diplomacy
runners.spotlight: 28,000gns yearling; sixth foal; half-brother to four winners including Plage De Havre (1m4f/12.5f; RPR 108), Batz (Group-placed 1m 2yo; 96) and Borjina (7f; 74); dam maiden half-sister to 1m 2yo Group 2 winner Rich Legacy; stable has low strike-rate with 2yos these days.
runners.comment: 28,000gns yearling; half-brother to four winners but likely a longer-term prospect

runners.name: Special Operations
runners.spotlight: 5,000gns yearling; eighth foal; brother to 7f AW winner Pascalia (RPR 69), half-brother to winners Leodis Dream (prolific 5f including 2yo; 106) and Battle Point (5f AW; 68); dam 5f 2yo winner (73); one of two runners for the stable; likely best watched on debut.
runners.comment: 5,000gns yearling with three winning siblings; dam 5f winner; likely best watched on debut

runners.name: Sweet Iris
runners.spotlight: Attracted a bit of support ahead of her Ripon debut (6f, good) 18 days ago but she got worked up in the stalls and never featured in the race; should do better at some point.
runners.comment: Never featured in a 6f novice at Ripon 18 days ago; should do better at some point

runners.name: The Resdev Rocket
runners.spotlight: Sent off at 33-1 when never in the hunt at Ayr (7f, good) 18 days ago; a big step forward is required.
runners.comment: Never-dangerous 33-1 shot when eighth at Ayr 18 days ago; big step forward essential

runners.name: Rule Of The Agency
runners.spotlight: 100-1, slowly away and always in rear at Beverley (7.4f, good) last month; should do better in time.
runners.comment: Low-key start to his career at Beverley (7.4f, good) last month; may need more time

races.race_name: Tomahawk Handicap

runners.name: Spirit Of Applause
runners.spotlight: It has been a while since he won on turf but he has turned in three solid efforts this summer, albeit over shorter trips and in a lower grade; others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Running okay this year but over shorter trips and in a lower grade

runners.name: Educating Rita
runners.spotlight: Won two 6f events (good/good to soft) for Michael Dods as a 2yo; drew a blank in 2025; 50-1 when down the field behind Magic Boy on her seasonal/stable debut 13 days ago.
runners.comment: Low-key stable/seasonal debut behind Magic Boy here 13 days ago; others are stronger

runners.name: Grant Wood
runners.spotlight: Below par on his last two starts but he went close at Ripon (6f, good) in May off a 3lb higher mark and his AW win in March was impressive; likely to pop up again soon.
runners.comment: Two AW wins this year; good third at Ripon in May has been followed by two lesser efforts

runners.name: Ingleby Archie
runners.spotlight: Had strong handicap form over C&D last summer and he is well handicapped on last July's second here (behind Aberama Gold); running well in small-field events this year; should give it another good go.
runners.comment: Conditions to suit, on a good mark and arrives in good form; each-way shout

runners.name: Bonnie's Boy
runners.spotlight: Ready winner of a 5f Class 5 handicap at Newcastle last October; low-key return to action over C&D six weeks ago; others bring more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Poor strike-rate and he made a low-key return to action here six weeks ago

runners.name: Glory Hyde
runners.spotlight: Four wins this season; not ideally positioned when down the field over C&D 13 days ago but, even so, an improved effort will be needed to defy this mark.
runners.comment: Had a fine year but she was well beaten over C&D 13 days ago; others appeal more

runners.name: Dorney Lake
runners.spotlight: Finally exploited a big drop in the weights when landing Class 5 at Doncaster (5.6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; similar form when second at Pontefract last week; 3lb ahead of the handicapper and one of two solid form contenders for Liam Bailey, although a lower draw would have been preferred.
runners.comment: 3lb well in after a good 2nd at Pontefract last week; stall 21 a nagging concern
runners.owner: Mrs C M Clarke, Foulrice Park Racing Ltd

runners.name: Aberama Gold
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; runner-up on his last two starts but this is more competitive and more minor money may be his best hope.
runners.comment: In-form C&D winner; should run his race but likely one or two will prove stronger

runners.name: Magic Boy
runners.spotlight: Well backed when coming from off the pace to beat 18 rivals over C&D 13 days ago; a 4lb rise doesn't look excessive; respected.
runners.comment: Strong finish to reward market support over C&D 13 days ago; respected up 4lb

runners.name: Who Wants Me
runners.spotlight: Underwent a second wind operation prior to her return to action in May and it appears to have done the trick, as she followed her breakthrough win at Carlisle (7f, good to firm) with a comfortable success at Ayr (5f, good) 19 days ago; 6lb higher and connections now reach for cheekpieces; still respected in current form.
runners.comment: Chasing a hat-trick after wins at Carlisle (7f) and Ayr (5f); now tried in cheekpieces

runners.name: Fiscal Policy
runners.spotlight: Good run of form came to a halt when 17th of 19 behind Magic Boy here 13 days ago; while he wasn't ideally drawn on that occasion, he will need a full revival to emerge victorious.
runners.comment: Down the field behind Magic Boy here 13 days ago; needs to leave that well behind
runners.owner: S Thompson, Mrs R Carr & G Shields

runners.name: Tiva
runners.spotlight: Won a 5f handicap off this mark at Newmarket (good to firm) last August; she has run some fair races this year but her latest effort (tried in cheekpieces, usual visor back on today) wasn't one of them; has tackled 6f only once in her 18-race career and that was in Listed company.
runners.comment: On a winning mark but not sure she's in the form required to capitalise; rare 6f run today

runners.name: Dicko The Legend
runners.spotlight: Bids for his third straight win in this race, 2lb higher than for his 2024 win and 1lb higher than 12 months ago; slow starts have been an issue in recent outings but he retains ability and it will be no surprise to see him go well with cheekpieces now given a go.
runners.comment: Bidding to win this race for a third straight year; cheekpieces given a go; interesting
runners.owner: Mrs S Hibbert, Foulrice Park Racing Ltd

runners.name: Alpha Magic
runners.spotlight: Fair reappearance at Pontefract but that hasn't been a springboard to better things; down the field behind Magic Boy here 13 days ago.
runners.comment: Not built on his reappearance fourth; midfield behind Magic Boy here latest; opposable

runners.name: Tough Enough
runners.spotlight: Still seeking a first win for this yard and, although he continues to drop down the weights, this looks too competitive.
runners.comment: Dropping down the weights but yet to win for this yard and this looks too competitive

runners.name: Sugar Baby
runners.spotlight: Landed the ninth win of his career when keeping on well in a Class 5 at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) five weeks ago; 4lb higher mark in a stronger race could find him out.
runners.comment: Ready win at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) five weeks ago; now 4lb higher in a better race
runners.owner: Hard Held Partnership And Angus Racing

runners.name: Rajaking
runners.spotlight: Yet to win a handicap but he shouldn't be long in putting that right judged on his last two runs at Windsor and Newmarket (both 6f, good to firm); one to take seriously.
runners.comment: Yet to win a handicap but last two runs have both been encouraging; one to take seriously

runners.name: Beattie Is Back
runners.spotlight: Has not matched this year's AW form since returned to turf; should be well treated now but not sure stall 22 will be an advantage.
runners.comment: Has not found his best on turf this summer; stall 22 doesn't look a positive either
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd

runners.name: HK Fourteen
runners.spotlight: Ended 2024 on the up and he continued the good work last season, winning three turf handicaps (5f); the handicapper has been on top since and this year's two runs leave him with a point to prove.
runners.comment: Yet to shine this year but he is edging back down the weights; others stronger this time

runners.name: Raatea
runners.spotlight: Didn't run badly in the corresponding race 12 months ago when an unconsidered 50-1 shot (after nine months off); running well on AW when last seen but this veteran may find a few stronger this time.
runners.comment: Fair run in this race last year; running creditably when last seen; vulnerable on return

runners.name: Almarada Prince
runners.spotlight: Made the frame in big-field C&D handicaps on his last two runs; would have finished much closer 13 days ago but for being hampered in the closing stages; mark left unchanged and he should be in the thick of the action once again.
runners.comment: Good C&D runs on last two starts, hampered late 13 days ago; more appealing than many

runners.name: Tolstoy
runners.spotlight: Drew a blank in 2025 but he has slipped a long way in the weights; absent since a poor run at Newcastle (7f) in February; headgear absent for his return and dropping back to 6f isn't sure to suit.
runners.comment: On a dangerous mark but dropping back to 6f after an absence is a concern

races.race_name: British EBF Lyric Fillies' Stakes (Listed Race)

runners.name: Diamond Rain
runners.spotlight: Placed in two North American Grade 1s last August/November; improved for May's comeback run here when short-headed in Group 3 at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) four weeks ago, when clear of the third; leading form claims.
runners.comment: Short-headed in Group 3 at Newcastle four weeks ago and holds leading form claims

runners.name: Estissa
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-4 when winning on handicap debut at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW) in May before good third in 3yo Listed race at Sandown (1m, good to firm); her dam was a 1m2f/9.5f winner at the top level for connections and she could have more to offer now up in trip; in good hands to progress; interesting.
runners.comment: Listed third over 1m at Sandown latest; this 3yo could have more to offer now up in trip

runners.name: Qilin Queen
runners.spotlight: Listed winner at Newbury (1m2f, good to firm) last May and added a Group 2 win at Longchamp (1m4f, good to soft) last July; soundly beaten in Group 1 races on her two starts this season and she could do with settling better than at the Curragh last month, but not written off back down in grade.
runners.comment: Listed/Group 2 wins last May; soundly beaten so far this season but in Group 1 races

runners.name: On Message
runners.spotlight: Won two in a row (7f novice then 8.6f handicap) before staying on for close third at Goodwood (1m2f, good) in May in a race that has worked out extremely well; well beaten in the Oaks at Epsom last time but the good to soft ground may not have suited; this 3yo retains potential for her good yard.
runners.comment: Well beaten in the Oaks but on good to soft; Listed third previously; retains potential

runners.name: Regal Charm
runners.spotlight: Reappeared with an easy win in Class 4 handicap at Salisbury (1m2f, soft) last month; has also won on fast ground; this 4yo is lightly raced and it remains to be seen where her limitations lie, but she's in a much hotter race than last time and others have more substance to their form.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 4yo; impressive at Salisbury on reappearance but that was a Class 4 handicap

runners.name: Miss Justice
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo who was a Listed winner and Group 3 runner-up for the Gosdens last year; with a new yard this term and she's been a respectable fourth in Listed and Group 2 races on her last two runs; each-way chance.
runners.comment: Listed winner last August; respectable efforts on last two runs and has an each-way chance

races.race_name: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Handicap

runners.name: Dolos Dream
runners.spotlight: 5f novice winner as a 2yo; made a winning handicap debut with her front-running success at Pontefract last month and a subsequent defeat on soft ground (6f) is easy enough to excuse; still has untapped potential.
runners.comment: Had trip/ground excuses last time; fair mark judged on Pontefract win; solid contender

runners.name: Explosive Finnish
runners.spotlight: 0-8 but he has been banging at the door this year, placed four times between April and June; not at his best here (6f, good) four weeks ago but it was still a fair run and dropping back in trip won't hurt.
runners.comment: Run of placed efforts came to a halt last month but the drop in trip looks a positive

runners.name: Liverpool Star
runners.spotlight: Just one win (6f, good) to his name from 14 attempts and that came at a lower level; others bring greater potential this time.
runners.comment: Modest strike-rate and suspicion he will prove vulnerable in a Class 4

runners.name: Space Bear
runners.spotlight: 6f win at Yarmouth in April and she has been placed on her last two runs, beaten just a nose at Thirsk on the first occasion; has the ability to be in the thick of it again.
runners.comment: Yarmouth win (6f) in April and went mighty close at Thirsk last month; one to consider

runners.name: Dragon Spin
runners.spotlight: Twice a winner in 5f handicaps this year, latterly at Thirsk last month; creditable fourth in a Class 4 at Doncaster last time but she will need another career best to come out on top.
runners.comment: Two 5f wins this year; fair fourth in a Class 4 latest; personal best needed to win

runners.name: Slot
runners.spotlight: 0-7 but she arrives having finished second in handicaps at Newcastle (5f, AW) and Nottingham (6f, good to firm) on her last two starts; up in class today and could prove vulnerable for win purposes again.
runners.comment: Runner-up over 5f and 6f on last two starts; needs more now upped in class

runners.name: Kinnalargy
runners.spotlight: Ran okay at Thirsk (5f, good) in May but that is sandwiched by two lesser efforts; others look more persuasive.
runners.comment: One good run sandwiched by two lesser efforts this year; others look stronger

runners.name: Bravo Hotel
runners.spotlight: Finished third in four of his five 2yo starts; bled from the nose when fifth of seven in a race won by Dragon Spin on his seasonal return last month; not obviously ahead of his mark.
runners.comment: Reliable at two; bled from the nose when down the field on his seasonal return last month

runners.name: Nursia
runners.spotlight: Two modest turf runs either side of a cosy 6f AW win in January; still has time on his side but this opening mark doesn't look especially generous.
runners.comment: 6f AW win in January; neither turf start so convincing; opening mark looks tough

runners.name: U S S Charleston
runners.spotlight: This intermediate trip could suit but he was hit quite hard by the handicapper for his easy soft-ground win at Yarmouth in May and has been unplaced twice since; others look stronger.
runners.comment: Hit hard for an easy soft-ground win in May and unplaced twice since; others look stronger

runners.name: Go Vince Go
runners.spotlight: Three wins as a 2yo, including here (5f, good), and he has run some solid races in defeat this year; latest fourth here (5f, good) came in a Class 2; one to take seriously upped a little in distance and dropping back down in class.
runners.comment: Course winner; ran well in a stronger 5f handicap here last month; high on the list

runners.name: Anaisa
runners.spotlight: Won twice as a 2yo, notably a Listed success at Ripon last August; life has been tougher since and hopes rest on the drop in class and addition of a tongue tie giving her a lift.
runners.comment: Listed win as a 2yo; handicapper on top this time around; tongue tied now dropped in class

races.race_name: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Hanney Boy
runners.spotlight: Placed in three sprint maidens including over 6f at this track; took his form to a new level when a close third in a Naas Listed race over 5f last time; will be difficult to beat with a repeat of that effort.
runners.comment: Third in a Naas Listed race over 5f last time; will be hard to beat with a repeat of that

runners.name: Blooming Sally
runners.spotlight: Third foal; dam unplaced 7f (inc 2yo/AW; RPR 59), half-sister to French 1m2f/1m4f winner Motadarrek, out of useful 1m1f/1m2f winner; Eur8,000 yearling was a 10,000gns vendor buyback as a 2yo; yard is having a fine season so could run well on debut.
runners.comment: 10,000gns vendor buyback as a 2yo; yard is having a fine season so could run well on debut

runners.name: Tango Club
runners.spotlight: Fifth foal; sister to Italian 6f winner Rumba Club, half-sister to winners La Discoteca (Listed-placed 5f/5.5f 2yo; RPR 86) and Tees Aggregates (5f inc 2yo; 78); dam unraced; Eur6,000 vendor buyback as a yearling; decent pedigree and could run well on debut.
runners.comment: Eur6,000 vendor buyback as a yearling; decent pedigree and could run well on debut

runners.name: Letmeentertainyou
runners.spotlight: Third foal; dam French 1m5f winner, half-sister to useful winners Show Me (1m1f-1m4f) and Honeymoon Cocktail (6.5f-1m4f), out of Listed-placed 5.5f/1m1f 2yo winner; Eur26,000 yearling is by a Phoenix Stakes winner and could run well on debut.
runners.comment: Eur26,000 yearling is by a Phoenix Stakes winner and could run well on debut

runners.name: Walk On Harry
runners.spotlight: Fifth of 10 in a Naas barrier trial and ran respectably in a strong 6f Curragh maiden on debut; should have improved from that and be more involved today.
runners.comment: Ran respectably in a strong Curragh maiden on debut; should have improved from that

runners.name: Capital Of Pride
runners.spotlight: Sixth foal; half-brother to winners Last Crusader (6f 2yo/5f Listed; RPR 106), Cool Azul (6f; 85) and Game Breaker (6f inc 2yo; 82); dam Group-placed 6f 2yo winner (98); Eur50,000 yearling is by a young sire who is doing well; respected yard so check the market.
runners.comment: Is by a young sire who is doing well; respected yard so check the market

runners.name: Best Love
runners.spotlight: Promise on debut in a Curragh maiden but swerved and unseated rider early on next time; best watched for now.
runners.comment: Promise on debut in a Curragh maiden but unseated rider early on next time; best watched

runners.name: No Time Faults
runners.spotlight: Slight improvement from Naas debut to Navan next time but needs major progress to take this.
runners.comment: Slight improvement from Naas debut to Navan next time but needs major progress to win

runners.name: Whammy
runners.spotlight: Beaten approx' 12l in 5f maidens at Dundalk and Naas so will have to find significant improvement; hood and tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Beaten approx' 12l in 5f maidens at Dundalk and Naas; needs significant improvement

runners.name: Roeillaun
runners.spotlight: Started at 80/1 and beaten 11l on debut at Naas so has to find lots of improvement.
runners.comment: Started at 80/1 and beaten 11l on debut at Naas so has to find lots of improvement

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Rated Race

runners.name: Sirocco Sands
runners.spotlight: Solid on first two maiden runs over C&D (sft) and the Curragh (6f; gd); the winner of latter contest won the Railway Stakes last weekend; off the mark in a 6f York novice since but seems to have the speed for this trip too; big player.
runners.comment: Off the mark in a 6f York novice but seems to have the speed for this trip too; big player

runners.name: Lars Soldier
runners.spotlight: Won a Curragh maiden over this trip in heavy ground on second start; posted a solid effort in a 6f Group 3 next time but has been below his best twice since; can be keen so the drop back in trip should be fine but needs his best.
runners.comment: Below his best the last twice; the drop back in trip should be fine but needs his best

runners.name: Grayrobin
runners.spotlight: Was well beaten on debut when trained by Archie Watson but much better for this yard when landing a Bellewstown maiden over this trip; this demands more but could be capable of delivering it.
runners.comment: Won a Bellewstown maiden over this trip; this demands more but could be capable of it

runners.name: Celestial Crown
runners.spotlight: Was just denied over C&D on debut (soft) but has been below that level twice since, albeit in Listed company last time; has to resume her progress.
runners.comment: Just denied over C&D on debut (soft) but has been below that level twice since; needs more

runners.name: Hi Corbett Court
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in two maidens over 6f and will have to find plenty of improvement.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in two maidens over 6f and will have to find plenty of improvement

runners.name: Star Prospect
runners.spotlight: Beat subsequent Listed winner Carry The Flag on debut in a Curragh maiden over this trip on soft; didn't progress at Naas next time before disappointing in the Norfolk Stakes; might be better on easier ground.
runners.comment: Curragh maiden winner on soft; not as good since and might be better on easier ground

runners.name: La Tache
runners.spotlight: Showed improved form to get off the mark in a Curragh maiden over this trip five days ago; has a habit of starting slowly but makes up for it by finishing well; faces a tougher task today giving away weight but is still a player.
runners.comment: Won a Curragh maiden over this trip five days ago; tougher task today giving away weight

runners.name: Belle Island
runners.spotlight: Best effort in five starts when third in a Dundalk maiden over this trip; has to improve plenty on recent efforts even getting weight from most of her rivals.
runners.comment: Has to improve plenty on recent efforts even getting weight from most of her rivals
runners.owner: Gary Devlin & N W T Dalzell

races.race_name: Doneraile Handicap

runners.name: Allsortz
runners.spotlight: Won a 6f Dundalk maiden in April and a C&D handicap in May on soft; just denied in a Curragh handicap next time but disappointing at York since; has a chance if rebounding.
runners.comment: C&D winner was disappointing at York last time but has a chance if rebounding

runners.name: Ipanema Queen
runners.spotlight: Speedy filly won twice in Listed company last year; has found life tougher this term but some solid handicap efforts including at Royal Ascot; found Group 2 company too tough at the Curragh las weekend but has a shout here.
runners.comment: Found Group 2 company too tough at the Curragh las weekend but has a shout here
runners.owner: Stonestreet Stables, LLC & AMO Racing Limited

runners.name: Kendall Roy
runners.spotlight: His seven wins include this race in 2024; added a valuable handicap in Bahrain over the winter; bounced back to form after a break when winning a C&D Listed race last month but found Group 2 company too tough at the Curragh last weekend; this is easier despite his hefty weight.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner; Curragh Group 2 was too tough last weekend and a better chance here
runners.owner: Miss Kate McGivern & Thomas Hore & Shane M Power

runners.name: Eclairage
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; all four wins have come on AW but front-runner was second in this race last year off 2lb lower; just denied at Dundalk last time and 2lb lower on turf, so should go well.
runners.comment: Second in this race last year off 2lb lower; just denied at Dundalk last time; can go well

runners.name: Rosie Frith
runners.spotlight: Won a C&D maiden last year and scored for the third time when taking a Bellewstown handicap recently; solid effort at Dundalk since off this mark but needs a bit more.
runners.comment: C&D winner; solid effort at Dundalk last time off this mark but needs a bit more

runners.name: Genesis
runners.spotlight: Has been in the form of his life this season, winning the Rockingham handicap despite being 3lb out of the weights; ran a belter from the front in the Scurry handicap last weekend but didn't see out that longer trip; solid chance off the same mark if bouncing out of that race.
runners.comment: Rockingham h'cap winner was 3rd in the 6f Scurry h'cap 6 days ago; chance if still fresh

runners.name: Howd'yadoit
runners.spotlight: Won for the third time when taking a Navan handicap in May; a decent effort in a Naas conditions race two starts ago but was disappointing in a Dundalk handicap 12 days ago when reported coughing.
runners.comment: Disappointing in a Dundalk handicap 12 days ago when reported coughing

runners.name: Fox In Flight
runners.spotlight: Won a Dundalk maiden over this trip last December and several good runs in defeat since including second to Sarahmae over C&D; needs more from 3lb out of the handicap and seems yard's second-string.
runners.comment: Has run well over C&D but needs more from 3lb out of the handicap

runners.name: Chicago Call
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner over 6f last year has mostly faced stakes company since and run well in defeat at times; drops to this trip for the first time with cheekpieces added; the drop in grade is a help.
runners.comment: Drops to this trip for the first time with cheekpieces added; drop in grade is a help
runners.owner: Samuel M Mencoff & Anthony Paul Smurfit

runners.name: Sarahmae
runners.spotlight: Has been in career-best form this season, winning over C&D and at Down Royal before just failing to catch Genesis in the Rockingham Handicap at the Curragh; up another 5lb but can be a player; beaten 6l in Listed contest over 6f at Naas on Wednesday.
runners.comment: Just failed to catch Genesis in the Rockingham handicap at the Curragh; up 5lb; a player
runners.owner: Mary B Hogan & Michael M O'Brien

runners.name: Erosandpsyche
runners.spotlight: Won this race in 2022 when trained by Paddy Twomey; only one win since but has run with credit several times this season, notably behind Kendall Roy over C&D last month; not as good behind Genesis in the Rockingham Handicap.
runners.comment: Third to Kendall Roy over C&D last month; not as good behind Genesis in the Rockingham

races.race_name: Navigation Road Maiden

runners.name: Trek Home
runners.spotlight: Hasn't finished outside the first four in four maiden starts; improved again to go close at Navan (6f, gd) 13 days ago, beaten two noses into third, front three pulling nicely clear; improving sort who should be in the mix; cheekpieces go on.
runners.comment: Consistent; beaten a short head into third at Navan lto; in the mix; cheekpieces
runners.owner: J Kirkland & Mrs J M Ryan

runners.name: Lohoobb
runners.spotlight: Steadily improved in seven starts in Britain for Owen Burrows; best run latest when narrowly beaten favourite off 74 in handicap at Ffos Las (6f, gd) 31 days ago; starts out for new yard and stays 7f; experience edge but vulnerable to less-exposed rivals.
runners.comment: Seven starts in Britain 6f/7f; narrowly beat off 75 lto; vulnerable to improver; new yard

runners.name: Feel Happy
runners.spotlight: Well-bred filly; promising debut when fourth in strong Naas maiden (three ahead have won since) over 1m on good; step backwards when beaten 7.5l into sixth as 5-4 favourite at Limerick over 7f 35 days ago (had winner behind her on debut); soft ground a possible excuse that day; definite player if reproducing debut run down in trip.
runners.comment: Good debut in strong maiden at Naas; below-par next time on soft; player if bouncing back
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Stooked
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to four winners, inc Irish Territory (US 1m turf; RPR 105); dam Listed-placed 1m2f winner (91), half-sister to Ghaiyyath; promising debut when beaten a head by more experienced rival at the Curragh (7f, g-f) six days ago; drop in trip should be no problem and she can go close again.
runners.comment: Promising debut six days ago, beaten by more experienced rival; down in trip; can go close

runners.name: Andaman Fifty
runners.spotlight: Palace Pier filly, half-sister to Listed-placed 1m 2yo winner; shaped with lots of promise on debut at Sligo (6f, sft) when running out of road late on to reel in Baiana, beaten a neck having been poorly placed (dwelt at the start); greenness got her beat so she should improve a lot and is a leading player.
runners.comment: Unlucky not to win on debut at Sligo (slow away and green); should go close

runners.name: Finika
runners.spotlight: Improved plenty from low-key debut to be beaten 2.5l into third by Xerling in Cork maiden (5f, gd) 40 days ago; each-way claims if building on that back up in trip.
runners.comment: Improved from debut with a promising third at Cork 40 days ago; claims if building on that

runners.name: Dash Of Colour
runners.spotlight: 120,000euros 2yo breeze-up purchase by Havana Grey; dam 1m/1m2f winner (inc AW; RPR 82), half-sister to winners Tatsumaki (useful 6f/7f inc 2yo) and Ascot Adventure (5f-7f inc 2yo), out of 1m Listed winner; tongue-tie on; debuts for small yard.
runners.comment: 120,000euros 2yo; half-sister two winners (6f-7f); dam 1m/1m2f winner (RPR 82); tongue-tie

runners.name: Brigerbad
runners.spotlight: Far Above gelding; dam multiple 5f winner (inc AW; RPR 97), half-sister to useful 7f/1m winner Punch Your Weight, out of Group-placed 5f/6f 2yo winner Sun Slash; bred to be sharp; market can guide.
runners.comment: Dam multiple 5f winner (RPR 97), half-sister to two winners (5f-1m); gelded before debut

runners.name: Gaineamh Min
runners.spotlight: 15,000euros yearling by Profitable; dam 5f/6f winner (RPR 94), half-sister to US Graded stakes-placed 1m1f winner Excelerina, out of Listed-placed 5f winner; yard can get maiden winners.
runners.comment: 15,000euros yearling; dam 5f/6f winner (RPR 94), half-sis to US Graded stakes-placed 1m1f

runners.name: Vinho Doche
runners.spotlight: 9,500euros yearling by Profitable; half-brother to winners Goblet Of Fire (1m1f-2m Flat inc AW, RPR 96; 2m hurdle) and Across Earth (1m6f Flat, 85; 2m hurdle); dam 6f-8.6f maiden (64), sister to useful 7f 2yo winner Cherokee Trail; wears blinkers and tongue-tie on debut.
runners.comment: 9,500euros yearling; half-brother to two winners (1m1f-2m hurdle); blinkers and tongue-tie

runners.name: Ocean Echo
runners.spotlight: Best maiden run when second at Cork in May over 7f on soft-heavy ground; solid run again when fourth on good at Fairyhouse; respectable runs in handicaps since but vulnerable in maiden company; drops in trip.
runners.comment: Best run came on sft-hvy but handles all; respectable runs in h'caps; vulnerable in maiden
runners.owner: R Scahill, S Begley, J & C Bourke

runners.name: Cladach
runners.spotlight: Well-bred 220,000euros yearling; very green when beaten 15l into fourth on debut 16 days ago; should know more now but needs plenty of improvement to threaten here; drops in trip for in-form stable.
runners.comment: Well-bred gelding; well beat on debut amid greenness; should know more now; down in trip

runners.name: Carry The Dream
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to 7f Group 3 winner and two other winners; too keen when beaten 12.5 lengths into eighth on debut on AW 12 days ago; hood goes on down in trip; yard won this last year but he needs a big step forward to figure.
runners.comment: Too keen, beaten 12.5l on debut 12 days ago; hood on down in trip; yard won this last year

runners.name: Grande Cuvee
runners.spotlight: Fair runs in 6f maiden at the Curragh (soft) and at Navan over 5f (yielding), beaten 6l into third by Namiid; up in trip on quicker ground now.
runners.comment: Fair opening two runs, beaten 6l into third at Navan lto; up in trip on quicker ground

runners.name: Strikepoint
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to yard's smart performer Indigo Five; looked like he'd improve for experience when seventh on debut at Navan (6f, gd) 13 days ago; likely one for longer-term.
runners.comment: Looked like he'd improve for experience on debut 13 days ago; likely one for longer-term

runners.name: Optics
runners.spotlight: No impact on sole run in 7f heavy ground maiden at Listowel 304 days ago.
runners.comment: No impact on sole run in 7f heavy ground maiden at Listowel 304 days ago

races.race_name: Follow Us On Social Media Handicap

runners.name: I'm Spartacus
runners.spotlight: Six-time AW winner; turf breakthrough in June when scoring at Fairyhouse (6f, gd) by 2.5l off 6lb lower; below-par effort at same track since; bit better 13 days ago at Limerick, beaten 6.5l into fourth over 7f; probably in the grip of the handicapper at present.
runners.comment: Turf breakthrough at Fairyhouse (6f, gd) in June; in grip of h'capper based on last three

runners.name: Jazzit
runners.spotlight: Best runs came when placed in 5f and 6f handicaps on AW this year; hasn't proven the same force on turf yet, albeit not beaten far in big fields last twice; up in trip.
runners.comment: Best form on AW; not beaten far in big fields last twice; up in trip

runners.name: Sovereign Banter
runners.spotlight: Found great consistency on AW last year, landing a 6f handicap in October and placing four times since; poor runs on turf last twice however.
runners.comment: Consistent on AW but poor runs on turf last twice

runners.name: You Smiled
runners.spotlight: Not much impact in maidens and ran poorly on handicap debut 21 days ago; not an obvious candidate.
runners.comment: Not much impact in maidens and ran poorly on handicap debut 21 days ago.

runners.name: Love Bomb
runners.spotlight: Won nursery over 5f on yielding at Down Royal in September off 15lb higher; struggled since and no real encouragement she's ready to win again based on last four starts.
runners.comment: Nursery winner off 15 higher last year; no sign of winning again of late

runners.name: Snowballs
runners.spotlight: 12-race maiden, shaped well over 5f on good when fifth at Naas in June; two lesser runs since and needs step up in trip to have positive effect.
runners.comment: Shaped well over 5f at Naas in June but followed it with two lesser runs; up in trip

runners.name: Billboa
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW winner is 0-6 on turf and didn't threaten when beaten 5.5l into ninth at Naas (5f, gd) 20 days ago in first-time tongue-tie; blinkers added now up in trip.
runners.comment: Three-time AW winner but hasn't threatened in six on turf; blinkers added to tongue-tie

runners.name: Rosato
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner (6f, yielding and good) who hasn't threatened in three starts this term; beaten 7.5l at Fairyhouse 42 days ago when well-backed; dropped 2lb; each-way claims.
runners.comment: Three-time winner; not threatened three starts this year; beaten 7.5l lto; dropped 2lb

runners.name: Alandownunder
runners.spotlight: Moderate form in six starts but did go well for a long way until short of room and fading at Roscommon 24 days ago in first-time blinkers; dropped 4lb and can play a part down in trip.
runners.comment: Went well for a long way over 7f before fading lto in blinkers; can figure back in trip
runners.owner: Rob Egan/Kilmichael Racing Syndicate/Kieran P Cotter

runners.name: El Fontenaro
runners.spotlight: 19-race maiden but is starting to find some consistency having finished runner-up the last twice at Fairyhouse (6f, gd) and Limerick (7f, gd); looked a winner in waiting last time 13 days ago beaten 0.75l by Rappell, pulling clear of Whatswrongnow and I'm Spartacus behind; should go close off 5lb higher back in trip.
runners.comment: 19-race maiden, second last twice, finished ahead of two rivals today lto; should go close

runners.name: Jampa Ling
runners.spotlight: Went close over 6f on AW in February; first turf run of note when third at Fairyhouse behind I'm Spartacus last month; below that last twice and needs more.
runners.comment: Second in AW maiden; ran well in third at Fairyhouse but followed that with two poor runs

runners.name: Dubai Opulence
runners.spotlight: Little to shout about in first four starts but improved to be beaten 2.75l into fourth at Navan (6f, gd) 13 days ago; 5lb out of the handicap that day so could be well treated.
runners.comment: Improved finished fourth beaten 2.75l at Navan 13 days ago from 5lb out of h'cap; chance
runners.owner: Syndicates Racing/W Jones/N O'Hare/Kabin Racing Syndicate

runners.name: Auguste Gusteau
runners.spotlight: Modest efforts in four maidens from 5f-7f, beaten 28l over 7f 16 days ago; hard to assess on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Modest efforts in four maidens from 5f-7f, beaten 28l over 7f 16 days ago; h'cap debut
runners.owner: One Eight Seven Four Syndicate/Paul J Cahill

runners.name: Whatswrongnow
runners.spotlight: 33-race maiden who has been consistent this year from 5f to 7f but has climbed 9lb in the handicap without winning; beaten 1.75l into fifth over 5f at Down Royal seven days ago; should be thereabouts again.
runners.comment: 33-race maiden consistent this year but steadily climbing in h'cap; should be thereabouts

runners.name: Platino Bianco
runners.spotlight: Gained first turf win in big-field 5f race at Naas last month; beaten 3.5l into fifth off 5lb higher at Bellewstown 21 days ago; wide trip that day and looked ready for 6f again; can continue to give good account.
runners.comment: First turf win over 5f at Naas; ran fine off 5lb higher lto; step back to 6f should suit

runners.name: Niobite
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in three deep maidens from 6f-1m2f; makes handicap debut.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in three deep maidens from 6f-1m2f; makes handicap debut

runners.name: Ballerina Dancer
runners.spotlight: Beaten average of 20l in three maidens from 7f-1m; makes handicap debut.
runners.comment: Beaten average of 20l in three maidens from 7f-1m; makes handicap debut

runners.name: Heart Of Eternity
runners.spotlight: Failed to make an impact in six runs for this yard, particularly on last two turf starts; difficult to make a case for.
runners.comment: Failed to make an impact in six runs for this yard, particularly on last two turf starts.

runners.name: The Cosy Corner
runners.spotlight: No impact in three maidens and needs to step forward plenty from handicap and stable debut 13 days ago.
runners.comment: No impact in three maidens and needs to step forward plenty from h'cap debut 13 days ago

runners.name: Captain Ciano
runners.spotlight: 13-race maiden wasn't beaten far when eighth at Bellewstown (1m, gd) earlier this month after missing break; never got involved on AW 12 days ago; needs improvement down in trip.
runners.comment: Shaped ok at Bellewstown; couldn't get involved on AW lto; needs improvement down in trip

runners.name: Hastily
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner, including when springing a 22-1 surprise in this race last year off 1lb lower; good second at Bellewstown in August over 1m; gone completely off the boil since but drop back in trip a positive at least.
runners.comment: Last year's winner followed up with good second in August; completely off the boil since

races.race_name: Racing Again August 3rd Handicap

runners.name: Borora Aura
runners.spotlight: Couple of decent runs early on in a maiden and claimer; well-held in handicaps since; ran to form in claimer at Fairyhouse (1m2f, gd) when 6l second to Pass The Buck; needs improvement up in trip to defy mark.
runners.comment: Ran up to form when second in claimer 16 days ago; improvement needed up in trip

runners.name: Connecteo
runners.spotlight: Looked well-treated when pulling clear with Adel on handicap debut over 1m4f (yielding) at Roscommon in May; below that on soft next time and faded into seventh at Naas 20 days ago; that race suited closers and he was up with a strong pace so he's not one to give up on; each-way chance.
runners.comment: Looked well-h'capped at Roscommon and excuses last twice; ew chance

runners.name: Guildhall Graduate
runners.spotlight: Put in best effort in handicaps when beaten 4l into fourth (0.75l behind Point Cartwright) at Killarney 11 days ago, shaping well from the rear; extra trip a positive but needs a sound pace to aim at.
runners.comment: Best effort when beaten 4l into fourth lto, shaping well from rear; extra trip a positive

runners.name: Wingit
runners.spotlight: Stayed on to good effect to finish fifth at Killarney over 1m and went like the best horse for a long way over 1m5f four days ago at Ballinrobe before being left behind by 50-1 shot; should go well dropped slightly in trip for in-form stable.
runners.comment: Handled step up in trip, went well for a long way before distant second lto; can go well

runners.name: Amethyst Stone
runners.spotlight: Hasn't landed much of a blow in two handicaps; needs cheekpieces and stable switch to spark something.
runners.comment: Hasn't landed much of a blow in two handicaps; needs cheekpieces and stable switch to help

runners.name: Tavarua
runners.spotlight: Debut sixth at Gowran Park (7f, soft) not devoid of promise but soundly beaten since and never a factor over 1m at Killarney 10 days ago; up in trip.
runners.comment: Never a factor at Killarney lto; debut had some promise but needs improvement up in trip

runners.name: Point Cartwright
runners.spotlight: Has been knocking on the door of late having placed for a third time running at Killarney (1m3f, gd) 11 days ago, beaten 3.25l into third by Chicago Moon; takes a while to get going so this extra furlong and cheekpieces could help; should be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Placed last three times; shapes as if this extra furlong and cheekpieces can help; player

runners.name: Canon Law
runners.spotlight: Reversed form with Point Cartwright when 2.5l second to Chicago Moon at Killarney, sticking on well having set a good gallop; raised 2lb and should give a bold bid again.
runners.comment: Had Point Cartwright behind when second at Killarney lto; should make bold bid again

runners.name: Cadreville
runners.spotlight: Not far off some of these rivals based on recent runs at Naas and Killarney; needs to find improvement from somewhere to reverse form; hopes pinned on extra furlong.
runners.comment: Not far off some of these recently; needs the extra furlong to bring about improvement

runners.name: Millhone
runners.spotlight: Been improving steadily in handicaps the last three runs and relished the step up to 1m3f at Gowran Park 20 days ago when running the progressive Rodeo Blues to within half a length; had Point Cartwright half a length behind and meets that rival on same terms now.
runners.comment: Improved for step up to 1m3f lto; matched closely with Point Cartwright on that form
runners.owner: N J Hitchins & Mrs John M Weld

runners.name: Glen Echo
runners.spotlight: Had shown little prior to second start in handicaps when beaten 4.25l into third at Down Royal (1m5f, gd) seven days ago; drop in trip doesn't seem ideal based on that but a player nonetheless; wears first-time cheekpieces; one of two for trainer.
runners.comment: Improvement on second h'cap start lto when third; drop in trip not ideal; cheekpieces

runners.name: Nathema
runners.spotlight: No impact in testing ground on first two starts but improved on yielding at Limerick (1m4f) 90 days ago when beaten 15l into fourth by Chablis Rock; ran in snatches in rear that day so needs to be sharper on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Improved on less testing ground when fourth lto; improvement needed on h'cap debut

runners.name: Kuma Queen
runners.spotlight: Three-figure odds and ran like it three times in maidens; steps up in trip on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Three-figure odds and ran like it three times in maidens; steps up in trip on h'cap debut

races.race_name: Tote Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Kasper Hauser
runners.spotlight: Now 0-11 over hurdles but twice placed in Bellewstown maidens, including early this month after forcing much of pace; has his chance in what appears a weak maiden.
runners.comment: Twice placed in Bellewstown maidens; more probably needed to play a leading role
runners.owner: Trevor Payne/One In A Million Syndicate

runners.name: Monntie
runners.spotlight: Rated 63 after three Flat runs for the Hartys; surpassed market expectations on hurdles debut when second to a long odds-on winner at Bellewstown, not quite at same level when fourth at Cork a fortnight ago on quicker ground; encouraging jockey booking (claimer-ridden both starts) and should go well off a light weight.
runners.comment: Promise in two efforts hurdling; encouraging jockey booking, can go well off light weight

runners.name: Open Approach
runners.spotlight: Pick of three maiden runs when rallying fourth over 2m6f at Downpatrick, well held after racing handier at Limerick (2m4f) on latest; back in trip now.
runners.comment: Tried over longer trips of late, not sure drop in distance will suit

runners.name: Pebble Island
runners.spotlight: Modest Flat maiden but has shown a bit more hurdling, notably staying on fourth in 2m1f Bellewstown novice early this month (good), raced handier at Sligo latest but didn't seem to get home when fourth (4.5l off third-placed Bobby Kirova) in 2m2f maiden; more needed.
runners.comment: Bellewstown promise wasn't backed up at Sligo; more needed

runners.name: Direct Approach
runners.spotlight: 70-rated Flat maiden with Donnacha O'Brien last year; couple of underwhelming runs in maiden hurdles for current yard, latest after 7 months' absence at Downpatrick 10 days ago; may come on for that comeback run.
runners.comment: Two hurdle runs haven't offered much but entitled to come on for recent comeback effort

runners.name: Bobby Kirova
runners.spotlight: Some promise in Flat maidens last year but has been disappointing in handicaps this term; recent hurdles debut was a bit more encouraging when third (Pebble Island 4.5l away fourth) in 2m2f Sligo maiden, despite some novicey jumping; more likely needed.
runners.comment: Sligo hurdles debut encouraging although will need to jump better here

runners.name: Earthwatch
runners.spotlight: Sandown 1m handicap winner for William Haggas (1m, good), well held in Curragh handicap last month (off 76) on latest; previous three runs over hurdles didn't offer that much, albeit carried out early on final occasion; may need more time to make his mark hurdling and has to concede weight all-round.
runners.comment: Fair sort on Flat in Britain but needs to improve on what we've seen so far hurdling

runners.name: I'm Gold
runners.spotlight: Order Of St George filly dropped away quickly at halfway on recent debut in Cork bumper; switches to hurdles.
runners.comment: Dropped away quickly at halfway on recent debut in Cork bumper; switches to hurdles

runners.name: Green Grass
runners.spotlight: Saddex gelding is half-brother to Czech 7f winner Coolishaak; dam 7f winner (RPR 76), closely related to useful 1m-1m4f winner Havanna Belle; market best guide on debut.
runners.comment: Half-brother to Czech 7f winner Coolishaak; market best guide on debut

runners.name: Hurling Academy
runners.spotlight: Soldier Of Fortune gelding; half-brother to 2m hurdle winner Harty Cup; dam bumper/2m4f hurdle winner, half-sister to useful 2m1f/2m3f chase winner Sraid Padraig; market best guide on debut.
runners.comment: Half-brother to 2m hurdle winner Harty Cup; debutant worth a market check

runners.name: Pillartou
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in his point-to-point and modest efforts in maiden hurdles at Killarney and Cork; hard to make a case for.
runners.comment: Modest efforts in maiden hurdles at Killarney and Cork; hard to make a case for

runners.name: Rosarian
runners.spotlight: Closely related to bumper winner Miss Mini Bee; dam French 1m4f AQPS Flat and 2m1f chase/2m2f hurdle winner; ran okay in an academy hurdle on testing ground at Navan in December, market likely best guide on return.
runners.comment: Ran okay in an academy hurdle at Navan in December, market likely best guide on return

runners.name: Nuestro Caballo
runners.spotlight: Court Cave gelding was never sighted on last month's debut in Clonmel maiden; best watched for now.
runners.comment: Never sighted on last month's debut in Clonmel maiden; best watched for now

runners.name: Kenny's Jewel
runners.spotlight: Huge odds and ran accordingly in 3yo hurdles last autumn at Cork and Fairyhouse; best watched on return unless market speaks.
runners.comment: Huge odds and ran accordingly in 3yo hurdles last autumn at Cork and Fairyhouse

runners.name: Champ Young
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam US 2m1f hurdle winner, half-sister to winners, notably talented chaser Allmankind; dropped away quickly two out on Navan hurdles debut in December on testing ground; much quicker conditions here.
runners.comment: Well held on Navan hurdles debut in December on heavy; much quicker conditions here

races.race_name: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Press The Button
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner at Thurles last October (good-to-yielding) and promising hurdles debut second (third has won since) at Ballinrobe in late May (good); dropped away disappointingly in first-time cheekpieces at Bellewstown early this month however; headgear now left off and could be the one to beat if reproducing Ballinrobe run.
runners.comment: Ballinrobe second was good but Bellewstown run since disappointing; cheekpieces discarded

runners.name: Mysilverriverfeale
runners.spotlight: Showed some improvement when upped in trip, notably staying on late to chase home a hot favourite at Tramore (2m6f, good); didn't seem to stay over slightly longer trip here a week ago when fourth in a stronger maiden than this; back in trip and major claims.
runners.comment: Didn't seem to stay 2m7f here a week ago; potentially big player dropped in trip

runners.name: Cooladdi
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; chased home a clear winner in 2m5f Roscommon maiden a year ago (good) and best effort since in similar contest early this month, tracking leaders and every chance when fell two out; definite player if getting a run.
runners.comment: Every chance when faller two out at Roscommon, definite player if getting a run; reserve

runners.name: Blue Johnl
runners.spotlight: Blue Bresil half-brother to winners Celestial Park (2m4f hurdle) and Global Fortune (point); dam unraced sister to useful 2m5f-3m2f hurdler/chaser Warden Hill; point-to-point form doesn't amount to much but yard going well so worth a market check on rules debut.
runners.comment: Points' form doesn't amount to much but yard going well so worth a market check

runners.name: Perfect Order
runners.spotlight: By Lulamba's sire, Nirvana Du Berlais; dam won over fences in France, half-sister to smart 2m-2m2f hurdle winner Rolling Star; big odds, never sighted on recent debut in Wexford bumper; improvement quite likely now switched to hurdles.
runners.comment: Never sighted on debut in Wexford bumper; improvement quite likely now switched to hurdles
runners.owner: Call It What You Like Syndicate

runners.name: Facile Ocean
runners.spotlight: Placed on debut in Naas bumper last year for Tom Mullins; decent placed efforts on first two hurdling attempts for current yard in C&D maidens in May; more needed to play a leading role but has to be on the shortlist.
runners.comment: Placed in C&D maidens in May; more needed to play a leading role but shortlisted

runners.name: Texas Red
runners.spotlight: Brother to an Italian Grade 2 2m1f hurdle winner; ran okay in bumpers last year when with Ronald O'Leary; mildly encouraging hurdles debut for new yard at Downpatrick last month, good bit more likely needed here.
runners.comment: Mildly encouraging hurdles debut for new yard at Downpatrick, good bit more likely needed
runners.owner: John Henry & William Bates & Paul Hillis

runners.name: Gc Star Speed
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to a 2m hurdle winner; dam unraced sister to bumper/useful hurdler winner Grangeclare Lark; had a foal in 2024, pulled up after always trailing on belated debut in recent Cork maiden hurdle.
runners.comment: Had a foal in 2024; pulled up after always trailing on belated debut in  Cork maiden

runners.name: Ballyday Tysie
runners.spotlight: Affinisea mare is second foal; dam unraced half-sister to point winner Elusive Classic; limited appeal on breeding, debutante likely best watched.
runners.comment: Limited appeal on breeding, debutante likely best watched

runners.name: Kingston Silver
runners.spotlight: First reserve; Kingston Hill half-brother to winners Decision Time (1m4f/1m5f Flat; bumper/2m hurdle), Sergeant Wilson (bumper/2m hurdle) and Stucker Hill (2m5f/2m6f hurdle); dam 7f winner; market best guide on debut.
runners.comment: Half-brother to 3 winning hurdlers, market best guide on debut; reserve

runners.name: Doesthatmakesense
runners.spotlight: Big odds and soundly beaten in May, in Killarney bumper and pulled up in Limerick mares maiden hurdle; visor now fitted.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten twice in May, including pulled up in Limerick mares maiden; visor fitted

runners.name: Rumble Demosa
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to eight winners inc Hang In There (smart 2m-3m2f hurdle/chase) and Logical Song (useful 2m1f-3m4f hurdle/chase); dam French 2m1f hurdle winner; never sighted when well held on last month's debut at Downpatrick; may need more time.
runners.comment: Never sighted when well held on last month's debut at Downpatrick; may need more time

runners.name: Kidam Roque
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in two bumpers, only glimpses of form on the AW and pulled up after poor round of jumping on hurdles debut at Limerick in May for Eoin Griffin; yard debut.
runners.comment: Poor round of jumping on hurdles debut at Limerick in May for Eoin Griffin; yard debut

runners.name: Lengaruka
runners.spotlight: Cost 55,000GBP as a 2yo; half-brother to four winners inc French hurdle winners Norathir and Louvetot; dam Listed-placed French 1m3f/1m4f winner; 40-1, dropped away soon after halfway on Roscommon debut early this month; probably best watched for now.
runners.comment: Dropped away soon after halfway on recent Roscommon debut; probably best watched

runners.name: I Dont Really Care
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; dropped out before home turn when tailed off on debut in Thurles bumper in December; switches to hurdles on return.
runners.comment: Tailed off on debut in Thurles bumper in December; switches to hurdles on return; reserve

runners.name: Baymount
runners.spotlight: Weakened into midfield on debut in Thurles bumper in December and far too keen (also made respiratory noise) following month before pulled up in Clonmel maiden hurdle; has had a break since and reappears on much better ground but hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Far too keen at Clonmel back in January; reappears on much better ground but hard to fancy

runners.name: Fairy Meadow
runners.spotlight: 150-1, tailed off when fell last on belated debut for Tom Dreaper in Fairyhouse maiden in January 2025; hooded here on yard debut and market should be informative.
runners.comment: Poor effort on debut early last year; hooded on yard debut and market likely informative

runners.name: G N Jefferson
runners.spotlight: British point-to-point form nothing to shout about, nor his run in an Aintree bumper; tailed off last of 9 on yard/hurdles debut at Downpatrick 10 days ago; can only be watched.
runners.comment: Tailed off last of 9 on yard/hurdles debut at Downpatrick 10 days ago; can only be watched

runners.name: Tell Me See
runners.spotlight: Never counted when last of 9 on debut in good-class Leopardstown bumper over Christmas; switches to hurdles on return.
runners.comment: Never counted in good-class Leopardstown bumper at Xmas; switches to hurdles on return.

races.race_name: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)

runners.name: Demanding Gerry
runners.spotlight: Has a knack for finishing second (runner-up in four of last six starts); filled the second spot again on his return at Wexford in May (2m1f, good to yielding); just fourth at Downpatrick (2m2f, good) last time when outpaced before keeping on; should be thereabouts again.
runners.comment: Has a knack for finishing second; should be thereabouts once again

runners.name: Finnicky Filly
runners.spotlight: 1-24 over hurdles with the victory coming on heavy ground at Clonmel in December (2m1f, heavy) off 2lb higher; beaten 34l over fences at Roscommon in June (2m6f, yielding to soft) and 23l over hurdles at Sligo last time (2m5f, good).
runners.comment: Won a h'cap off 78 on hvy ground in Dec'; well beaten in recent outings

runners.name: Dream Shaper
runners.spotlight: 0-27 and his run at Sligo last time was the first time he has ever placed when taking a 3l third (2m5f, good); 1lb rise seems a bit harsh; needs more.
runners.comment: 0-27 and placed for the first time at Sligo last time; needs more.

runners.name: Sneddy Eddie
runners.spotlight: Three-time Flat winner has finished fifth in both starts for Gordon Elliott; just 6.25l behind the winner at Wexford (2m1f, good) but further back at Downpatrick (2m2f, good) last time; probably best suited by softer.
runners.comment: Three-time Flat winner has finished fifth in both starts for new yard; best form on soft

runners.name: Surviving Murmansk
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 45 starts came in a Tramore handicap hurdle off 3lb lower in August (2m1f, good); midfield finish over hurdles at Tramore in May, but tailed off on the Flat there last time.
runners.comment: 1-45; won off 3lb lower at Tramore in Aug'; midfield there over hurdles in May

runners.name: Whispering Willow
runners.spotlight: Made the breakthrough in some style at Punchestown in May (2m, good to yielding) off 86; respectable efforts over fences twice following that; disappointing reversion to hurdles at Roscommon (2m, good) last time when beaten 16l; capable of better.
runners.comment: Easy winner in May off 86; okay chase runs afterwards; disappointing over hurdles latest

runners.name: Movie King
runners.spotlight: AW winner in 2022, scored over hurdles at Down Royal in 2023 off 90; well beaten on the Flat when last seen in September; best watched on stable debut.
runners.comment: Scored over hurdles in 2023; well beaten when last seen in Sept'; best watched

runners.name: King Of The Greys
runners.spotlight: Modest enough form in maidens; pulled up in first handicap at Downpatrick last time; new hood needs to transform.
runners.comment: Modest m'den form and PU in first h'cap; new hood needs to transform

runners.name: Malbas
runners.spotlight: Added a second hurdles win at Kilbeggan last summer (2m, good) off this mark; beaten 30l+ in all four runs this season (two over fences); drop into 0-100 category for the first time since his win is the one smidgen of hope.
runners.comment: Won off this mark last summer; beaten +30l in four runs this year; back in 0-100 now

runners.name: Friar Hogan
runners.spotlight: Appears to have gotten the hang of things in his last two outings over 2m4f at Limerick; still in the fight when carried out at the second last in May (soft); confirmed that was no fluke when a 0.5l runner-up last time; if capable of reproducing that form away from Limerick then he has a big chance.
runners.comment: Gotten the hang of things in his last two runs at Limerick; chance if reproducing

runners.name: I'm Flattered
runners.spotlight: Won a Kilbeggan handicap hurdle in August (2m, good to yielding) off 94; midfield finishes since then; well behind on the Flat at Naas last month; cheekpieces are added to the tongue tie.
runners.comment: Won off 94 in Aug'; midfield finishes since then; well beaten on Flat latest

runners.name: Dark Berkshire
runners.spotlight: Very ordinary form in maidens and no real improvement in handicaps; 11th of 13 in first-time cheekpieces at Wexford (2m1f, good) last time.
runners.comment: Very ordinary form in m'dens and no real improvement in h'caps

runners.name: Burlington House
runners.spotlight: Showed progression in handicap hurdles late last year, finishing the year off with a 2l second at Limerick off 87 (2m, heavy); Flat return at Roscommon was not encouraging but may do better back over hurdles, although may prefer softer; new headgear tried.
runners.comment: Showed progression in h'cap hurdles late last year; Flat return was not encouraging

runners.name: Circus Act
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdles winner for James Nash, the latest in April last year at Down Royal (2m4f, good) off 2lb higher; signed off with a moderate effort in a Clonmel claiming hurdle for his former stable in May; stable debut for new yard on Flat at Bellewstown was nothing to shout about either.
runners.comment: Dual hurdles winner hasn't been at his best in recent outings

runners.name: Il Pirata
runners.spotlight: First reserve; no sign of winning potential from five starts; best watched.
runners.comment: Reserve; no sign of winning potential from five starts; best watched

runners.name: Backinabit
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; blinkers transformed him at Wexford (2m1f, good) last time, where he won by 3.25l; up 6lb but he's of interest if he runs; declared for 6.55 at Wexford on Thursday
runners.comment: Reserve; blinkers transformed him last time; raised 6lb for his win but of interest

runners.name: Mambo Du Large
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; big prices and well beaten in all three maidens.
runners.comment: Reserve; big prices and well beaten in all three maidens

runners.name: Barrogstown Girl
runners.spotlight: Progressive Flat handicapper in 2024, winning three times on good/yielding; three maiden hurdle runs haven't revealed much but potential improver entering handicaps and worth a market check.
runners.comment: Won three times on Flat in 2024; potential improver entering handicaps

runners.name: Flash The Badge
runners.spotlight: Beaten 20l on handicap debut at Punchestown (2m, good to yielding, 40-1) in May and his mark looks high for what he achieved in maiden hurdles.
runners.comment: Beaten 20l on h'cap bow in May; mark looks high for what he has achieved

races.race_name: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)

runners.name: Fabhcun
runners.spotlight: Handicap debutant; didn't show a whole lot in five maidens at 2m-2m6f on varying ground; others preferred.
runners.comment: Didn't show a whole lot in five m'dens over varying distances; others preferred

runners.name: Western Opera
runners.spotlight: 0-11; pulled up on stable debut at Wexford in May but ran one of her best races at Clonmel last month (2m1f, good) when a 4l fifth; hampered on two separate occasions when fourth over further at Limerick last time (2m7f, good); this trip is on the short side for her, but she appears to have found some form.
runners.comment: Appears to have found some form in her last two runs; this trip could be on the short side

runners.name: Bowgate Street
runners.spotlight: Made the breakthrough at Sligo in May (2m2f, good) off 84; soundly beaten in two runs following that but her runner-up finish here last time (2m3f, good) is evidence that she could yet add to her victory.
runners.comment: Won off 84 in May; her runner-up finish here last time suggests she could add to her tally

runners.name: Dearg Mor
runners.spotlight: Fared better in second handicap start at Wexford (3m, good to yielding) in May following the application of cheekpieces when a 15l fourth; in the lead turning for home here last time over 3m1f before fading into fourth; drop in trip should suit and can go well.
runners.comment: Faded into fourth over 3m1f here last time; drop in trip should suit; can go well

runners.name: Rizedda
runners.spotlight: Beaten +40l in both handicap starts, the latest of which came on seasonal return at Clonmel last month (2m7f, good); in good hands but hard to recommend on form.
runners.comment: Beaten +40l in both h'caps; hard to recommend on form but in good hands

runners.name: Bangor Lady
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in three runs this season, two of them in handicaps; hard to make a case for.
runners.comment: Well beaten in three runs this season, two of them in handicaps; hard to make a case for

runners.name: High Notions
runners.spotlight: Won her second maiden hurdle start at Fairyhouse in October (2m4f, yielding); her best run since then came here over 2m in May when a 5.5l third; didn't handle the track at Downpatrick last month.
runners.comment: M'den hurdle winner ran her best race since then when third here on penultimate
runners.owner: I'm Going To No Home Syndicate

runners.name: Brohatna
runners.spotlight: First reserve; positive efforts in maidens at Downpatrick and Kilbeggan but his handicap debut at Bellewstown (2m5f, good) was a step backwards, where he weakened quickly into seventh; tongue tie on now.
runners.comment: Reserve; positive efforts in m'dens but h'cap bow was a step backwards

runners.name: Lakewood Rose
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; consistent efforts in handicap hurdles until her run at Cork last time which was below her best; place chance if at her best.
runners.comment: Reserve; consistent efforts in h'caps until last time which was below her best

runners.name: Light Her Up
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; modest form, her 8l sixth at Ballinrobe on Tuesday was one of her better efforts; declared for 7.30 at Wexford on Thursday.
runners.comment: Reserve; modest form, her 8l sixth on Tuesday was one of her better efforts

runners.name: Brianna Lily
runners.spotlight: 1-25 over hurdles, the win coming over 3m on heavy ground at Clonmel in 2023; is now 13lb lower and he showed promise at Clonmel in May when a 4.75l third of ten (2m4f, good to yielding); hasn't matched that performance in three runs since.
runners.comment: Now 13lb lower than his win in 2023; decent third in May but hasn't matched that since

runners.name: Patrick Street
runners.spotlight: Three-time Flat winner is yet to score from six runs over hurdles; third at Punchestown (2m, good to yielding) in May was his best placing; okay efforts over fences and on the Flat since then; chance.
runners.comment: Three-time Flat winner was third over hurdles in May; chance

runners.name: Little Boy Sivola
runners.spotlight: Got to within 19l of the winner at Downpatrick (2m6f, good) last time, which was the closest he has gotten in five handicaps; weakened late on, so drop back in trip looks the right move but others make more appeal.
runners.comment: Finishing 19l behind the winner last time was best he has done in five h'caps

runners.name: Tawny Lea
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in opening two maiden hurdles and would have been the same story at Sligo only for she ran out at the last; hard to fancy now entering handicaps.
runners.comment: No sign of winning potential in m'dens; enters h'cap company now

runners.name: Lariat
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner is 0-27 over hurdles; pulled up when last seen in this sphere at Sligo in May (found to be lame post-race); positive efforts on the Flat since, second at Tramore over 2m last time; strike-rate is off-putting but he has a place chance if bringing his best back over obstacles.
runners.comment: 0-27 over hurdles but was second on Flat latest; place chance if bringing best

runners.name: O'Grady Cracker
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo has been soundly beaten in four starts, including Clonmel handicap in April last time; visor goes on now but others preferred.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in four starts inc' h'cap debut; others preferred

runners.name: Rare Times
runners.spotlight: Okay run in opening academy hurdle last year when fifth behind the useful Quinta Do Lago at Cork (2m2f, good); heavy ground was a possible excuse at Punchestown next time; got loose before the start in maiden company at Downpatrick in May when tailed off; may do better now in handicaps.
runners.comment: Ran okay on debut but below that twice since; may do better now in h'caps
runners.owner: Gerard Mullins & Ms Mary Mullins & Ms Margaret Mullins

runners.name: Laligurash
runners.spotlight: Unseated in both point-to-points; not much to go on in his three maidens, where he was well beaten; best watched unless the market speaks on his handicap bow.
runners.comment: UR in both points; well beaten in three m'dens; best watched unless market speaks

runners.name: Thirsty Work
runners.spotlight: 0-7 and yet to place; well beaten in both runs at Limerick this season, although on the second occasion she was sent off just 13-2; has never encountered ground better than yielding.
runners.comment: 0-7 and yet to place; well beaten in both runs this season; never raced on better than yld

races.race_name: Tote Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: In The Trenches
runners.spotlight: Finally made the breakthrough in a Downpatrick maiden hurdle in June (2m3f, good) at the 35th attempt, having placed on numerous occasions; didn't bring that momentum to a beginners' chase at Wexford last time when pulled up after he made a bad mistake at the first and lost his action; overall record is off-putting.
runners.comment: Finally made the breakthrough in a m'den on penultimate; 1-36 record is off-putting

runners.name: Laxxio
runners.spotlight: Put a line through his handicap debut in February when he was pulled up, having sweated before the off; ran his best race in a Bellewstown maiden hurdle in April when a 5.5l third (2m1f, yielding); didn't improve back there last time when weakened into fourth (2m1f, good); could go well on second handicap start.
runners.comment: Some promise in m'dens inc' fourth last time; could go well in second h'cap
