runners.owner: Mrs P Crampton & Oliver Crampton & DJCC Investments Limited

runners.name: You Done Well
runners.spotlight: Won at Limerick (2m3f, good) off 5lb higher last year; consistent sort has finished third in both runs for new yard; this is a higher grade compared to those outings but he's shortlisted.
runners.comment: Won off 5lb higher last year; consistent sort and third twice for new yard; shortlisted

runners.name: Magic Day
runners.spotlight: C&D winner off 2lb lower last year (yielding); form since then has not been anything to get excited about and she reverts to hurdles after two moderate chase efforts; cheekpieces go on now.
runners.comment: C&D winner off 2lb lower last year; reverts to hurdles after moderate chase efforts

runners.name: Marlpark
runners.spotlight: Has shown his best form at Clonmel but was pulled up there last month (2m1f, good); on the retreat when falling at the last at Ballinrobe last time (2m2f, good); blinkers go on now but recent form just moderate and this comes quick enough after his fall.
runners.comment: Just okay recent form and fell heavily at Ballinrobe three days ago; others preferred

runners.name: Andys Flame
runners.spotlight: Won a handicap chase at Kelso (2m4f, good) in April 2025, his first win since scoring over hurdles at Downpatrick (2m3f, good) in March 2022; heavy defeats in two runs over fences since return from a break so a revival is needed.
runners.comment: Heavy defeats over fences since return from a break so a revival is needed

runners.name: Tudorista
runners.spotlight: Showed promise in the second of her maidens for Gavin Cromwell at Ballinrobe (2m2f, good) but well beaten in three subsequent outings; ran one of her best races on stable debut back from a break at Cork (2m4f, good) when keeping on steadily for fourth; not ruled out
runners.comment: Ran one of her best races on stable debut last time when fourth after break; not ruled out

runners.name: Silly Mongoose
runners.spotlight: Slight ability in bumpers; won his third maiden hurdle over 2m here in June (good to yielding) despite racing keenly; tailed off in his first handicap at Limerick earlier this month (2m1f, good); a tongue tie is added to the previously worn hood; he's capable of more.
runners.comment: Won his maiden here on penultimate; tailed off on h'cap bow latest; can do better

runners.name: Mon Sheriffe
runners.spotlight: 0-13 and has failed to complete three of his last four runs; pulled up over C&D in April and unseated at the second at Clonmel last time; others more likely.
runners.comment: 0-13 over hurdles and has failed to complete his last two outings; others more likely
runners.owner: T Leopold, P Smith, D P Connolly & C Connolly

runners.name: In For The Night
runners.spotlight: Lost his form after gaining a first win at Naas in April last year off 107 (2m3f, good to yielding); switch of stable brought some mild promise at Clonmel last time when shaping as though that first run back could bring him forward.
runners.comment: Lost form since winning off 107 last year; mild promise on stable debut latest

races.race_name: Hurley Family Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Rusty Harkness
runners.spotlight: Useful level of ability in four hurdle starts over a variety of trips and ground, twice over 2m7f; clear second on chase debut at Limerick (2m7f, good) in May, having stumbled on landing after the last fence; sets the standard back hurdling.
runners.comment: Useful hurdles form at 2m7f and good chase debut latest; sets the standard back hurdling

runners.name: Giorgia Rose
runners.spotlight: Placed in four points, though the form did not amount to much; Tramore maiden hurdle third (2m6f, good) her best effort under rules, recent remote third at Bellewstown below that level; place claims.
runners.comment: Placings at Tramore and Bellewstown put her in the mix but likely more needed

runners.name: Le Questionnaire
runners.spotlight: Placed in both point-to-points and runner-up over hurdles in the spring at both Tramore and over 2m3f at Downpatrick; didn't appear to stay 3m at Punchestown on latest however, although was involved in scrimmaging after two out so could be worth this second chance at the trip.
runners.comment: Involved in scrimmaging two out at Punchestown so worth another chance at this trip

runners.name: Lord Lackendarra
runners.spotlight: Placed in three bumpers, moderate Tramore third the best of three attempts in maiden hurdles; of limited appeal.
runners.comment: Moderate Tramore third the best of three attempts in maiden hurdles; of limited appeal

runners.name: Ruled By The Sun
runners.spotlight: Well held in bumpers at Limerick and Downpatrick; probably best watched now switched to hurdles.
runners.comment: Well held in bumpers at Limerick and Downpatrick; best watched now switched to hurdles

runners.name: Installment
runners.spotlight: Recent Tramore comeback fourth (2m6f, good) his best effort yet, shaping as if this longer trip will suit; could go well.
runners.comment: Recent Tramore comeback fourth suggests more likely at this longer trip; respected

runners.name: O'Callaghan Can
runners.spotlight: Shaped with definite promise in a couple of bumpers here and again on hurdles debut at Downpatrick 10 days ago, staying on into third over 2m6f (good) after not fluent at last; more likely required here but could go well.
runners.comment: Recent Downpatrick hurdles debut offered plenty; could go well

runners.name: Barton Sky
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner in 2024, also runner-up last year; sole previous racourse outing came when midfield in 2m7f Limerick hunters chase in late 2024; best watched on hurdles debut for new yard.
runners.comment: Points' winner best watched on hurdles/yard debut

runners.name: Clone Cross
runners.spotlight: 0-8 over hurdles but chased home a 15l winner in 2m4f Wexford maiden in May and faded into third after last in 2m5f Bellewstown handicap early this month; retreating third when fell last in 2m5f handicap here a week ago; has it to do back in maiden company and not sure this return to a longer trip will suit.
runners.comment: Has it to do back in maiden company and not sure this return to a longer trip will suit

races.race_name: Egan Stone Kilbeggan Handicap Chase

runners.name: Milan Forth
runners.spotlight: Won off 5lb lower at Cork in January (2m4f, yielding to soft); excellent effort over C&D in May when 0.5l behind the winner (good); took fourth in a deeper contest here last time (2m4f, yielding); cheekpieces are added to the tongue tie and he's in the mix.
runners.comment: Excellent second over C&D in May; fourth in a deeper contest here last time; in the mix

runners.name: Costacurta
runners.spotlight: Won his maiden hurdle here by 17l in May last year (2m3f, good); made a positive chase debut at Tramore (2m, good) when a distant third, jumping left throughout; improved at Wexford next time when a 2.5l runner-up behind Garnacho in a novice chase (2m4f, good); 4lb better off with the winner now; big chance.
runners.comment: M'den hurdle winner here; 2.5l behind Garnacho last time and now better off at weights

runners.name: Freddie Robdal
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; three-time winning chaser, the most recent of them coming over C&D in April last year off 106 (yielding); pulled up at Thurles in February (2m2f, soft to heavy) but better effort at Downpatrick (2m4f, good) last month when a 9.75l fourth; that is something to build on back at a winning venue.
runners.comment: Three-time winning chaser inc' C&D off 106; okay fourth when last seen

runners.name: Rexem
runners.spotlight: Three wins over hurdles, 1-15 over fences; second twice over fences on decent ground at Musselburgh in January and his third at Wexford when last seen over fences earlier this month (2m4f, good) was positive, keeping on; fourth over hurdles here last time (2m4f, good); can go well.
runners.comment: Decent third at Wexford earlier this month when last seen over fences; can go well

runners.name: Grange Walk
runners.spotlight: Six-time winner (four over fences) is now 31lb lower than his last chase win in 2023; good effort when third of 13 at Ballinrobe in May (2m4f, good); 2m2f over hurdles last time at Sligo was on the short side for him; place chance.
runners.comment: Four-time chase winner was a good third on penultimate; place chance

runners.name: Prince Palace
runners.spotlight: Won a listed novice handicap chase at Navan last year off 114 but has lost his way; tailed off at Roscommon last month (3m1f, yielding to soft); unlikely.
runners.comment: Lost his way since winning a Listed novice h'cap chase off 114 last year; unlikely

runners.name: Linden Arden
runners.spotlight: Three runs earlier this year weren't great but he won three times last year, twice off breaks of 100+ days; his record when fresh provides hope that he could get involved here but he is perhaps best on softer, although he has won on good/yielding.
runners.comment: Won three times last year after breaks; that record suggests he could get involved

runners.name: Garnacho
runners.spotlight: Hurdles winner made a positive seasonal return at Listowel in May when second (2m5f, good to yielding) and that run set him up nicely to win his chasing debut at Wexford in a novice contest (2m4f, good), jumping soundly to repel Costacurta by 2.5l; turnaround at the weights with that rival should bring them closer.
runners.comment: Won his chasing debut last time when seeing off Costacurta; 4lb swing against him now

runners.name: Typical Thomas
runners.spotlight: Hasn't won since landing a listed handicap over fences at Cork in October 2023 (2m2f, yielding); not a bad run over hurdles at Downpatrick last month (2m2f, good); others preferred.
runners.comment: No wins since landing a listed h'cap chase in 2023; okay fourth over hurdles latest

runners.name: Clonbury Bridge
runners.spotlight: Six wins split evenly between hurdles and fences; 3lb higher than his last win at Fairyhouse in October (3m1f, yielding); pulled up at Ballinrobe back over fences last time (2m4f, good); a visor replaces the blinkers now.
runners.comment: Six wins split evenly between hurdles and fences; 3lb higher than last win; PU latest

runners.name: Tullybeg
runners.spotlight: Three-time winning chaser has a losing streak under rules stretching back to 2023; won a first point-to-point at Ballysteen in April but his runs in a hunter chase at Killarney and a handicap at Ballinrobe since then were just okay.
runners.comment: Won a point in April but losing streak under rules stretches back to 2023

runners.name: Golden Temple
runners.spotlight: Dual-winning hurdler is yet to place from four runs over fences; beaten 25l on handicap chase debut at Limerick in May (2m4f, good to yielding); beaten same distance over hurdles at Sligo last time when fourth; others preferred.
runners.comment: Yet to place from four runs over fences inc' on h'cap chase debut; others preferred

races.race_name: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase

runners.name: My Good Pal
runners.spotlight: Sole hurdles win came in 2m5f Wexford handicap last summer, pick of six attempts chasing when second in 3m Downpatrick handicap in May (good); tame Wexford effort early this month but has to be respected on overall profile (cheekpieces worn recently now ditched).
runners.comment: Penultimate Downpatrick second puts the 7yo on the shortlist

runners.name: Love Like This
runners.spotlight: Heavily-raced mare belatedly opened her account in 3m1f handicap hurdle here early this month (good); week later ran well off lower chase mark when third at Killarney (2m7f); not sure if this drop in trip will suit but each-way claims off handy mark again.
runners.comment: Winning hurdler here on penultimate; each-way claims off lower chase mark

runners.name: Doyen Magic
runners.spotlight: Last year's win (good-to-yielding) in this came off 87 and later scored over hurdles at Limerick on heavy; twice runner-up in handicap chases last winter on heavy, below best of late on better ground; ground concerns again here.
runners.comment: Last year's winner but ground concerns now

runners.name: Luimneach
runners.spotlight: Better hurdler than chaser, though last win came in 2023; 0-9 chasing, standout run when second in 2m5f Down Royal handicap in January off 97; none too fluent and met trouble in running on yard debut here in May; best form is on softer ground; drops in grade.
runners.comment: Better hurdler; drops in grade but prefers softer ground

runners.name: Hurricane Honey
runners.spotlight: Sole win came for Adrian Murray in 2m3f Downpatrick handicap hurdle a year ago (good), couple of decent runs afterwards in beginners chases; two comeback runs over hurdles should have her straight and not one to rule out.
runners.comment: Two comeback runs over hurdles should have her straight and not one to rule out

runners.name: Big Island
runners.spotlight: Hurdle winner over three years ago; 0-10 chasing, good C&D effort last summer, not so good of late, 3m probably too far on latest; can't rule out back at a more suitable trip.
runners.comment: 3m probably too far on latest; can't rule out back at a more suitable trip

runners.name: Island McCoo
runners.spotlight: Chase win came in 2m6f Tramore handicap last year, more recently has been hurdling, notably 3m1f handicap win here; held off 5lb higher in similar contest a fortnight ago but interesting back chasing here off 3lb lower mark.
runners.comment: Hurdles winner here last month; interesting back chasing here off 3lb lower mark

runners.name: Ixigreczed
runners.spotlight: Sole win came in 2m3f handicap hurdle here two years ago; 0-5 chasing, most recent Wexford handicap fifth only mildly encouraging.
runners.comment: Winning hurdler here; most recent Wexford handicap chase fifth only mildly encouraging

runners.name: Kilashee
runners.spotlight: Front-runner a better hurdler than chaser, and her last four runs over fences do nothing to dispute that, pulled up here a week ago, having been headed some way out.
runners.comment: Front-runner badly out of form of late, pulled up here last week

runners.name: Watty Show
runners.spotlight: Quite lightly raced mare is 0-8 hurdling, safely held of late in handicaps; half-sister won over fences so could improve for this switch to chasing.
runners.comment: Held of late in handicap hurdles; could improve for this switch to chasing

runners.name: My Policy
runners.spotlight: Maiden's best effort last year when runner-up in 2m2f handicap hurdle here; absent until pulled up halfway after never counting in 2m5f Bellewstown handicap hurdle early this month; only second attempt over fences now.
runners.comment: Promise here over hurdles last year; only second attempt over fences now

runners.name: Ferdia
runners.spotlight: On a long losing run and needs to improve markedly on recent efforts but is on a vastly reduced mark.
runners.comment: On a long losing run and needs to improve markedly on recent efforts

runners.name: Syracus Du Houx
runners.spotlight: Maiden under all disciplines, best hurdles form when second in 2m5f Punchestown maiden; sole chase effort came on penultimate when never sighted in Limerick handicap in March on soft; inadequate trip back hurdling last time; high enough mark still.
runners.comment: Only second attempt chasing and mark remains on the high side

runners.name: Mercurial Sea
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; 0-9 over hurdles but twice runner-up in Downpatrick mares' events, latest 10 days ago in 2m2f maiden (good); improving 5yo could be interesting on chase debut if getting a run.
runners.comment: Improving 5yo hurdler could be interesting on chase debut if getting a run; reserve

runners.name: Battle Of Benburb
runners.spotlight: Two hurdles wins came some time ago; 0-7 chasing, most recently back from point-to-points when pulled up in Cork hunters chase in April; hard to make a case for.
runners.comment: Winning hurdler but precious little to offer over fences to-date

runners.name: My Cullen
runners.spotlight: First reserve; maiden was placed in couple of handicap hurdles for Henrietta Knight last year; poor form so far for this yard, latest here last week over 2m7f.
runners.comment: Poor form so far for this yard, latest here last week over 2m7f; reserve

runners.name: Walkmethroughit
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; modest maiden hurdler, pulled up last twice in handicaps early in the year; debuts over fences here for new yard.
runners.comment: Modest maiden hurdler, pulled up last twice in handicaps; debuts over fences for new yard

races.race_name: Close Brothers Asset Finance Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: King's Castle
runners.spotlight: Eight wins divided between hurdling and the Flat; off the same mark as when narrowly beating Mrembo in this 12 months ago and returns off the same mark; penultimate run was on a par with that performance.
runners.comment: Won this last year off same mark; penultimate run was on a par with that performance

runners.name: Harlington
runners.spotlight: Has won on turf but boasts a far superior strike-rate on the AW and hasn't been that threatening on good to firm in his last two races.
runners.comment: Better horse on the AW; not that threatening on good to firm in last two races

runners.name: Symphony's Song
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced filly who kept on for fifth on handicap debut at Wolverhampton (8.6f; 50-1) and there could be more to come now she's sent further.
runners.comment: Fair fifth on handicap debut and there could be more to come now she's sent further

runners.name: Imperial Cult
runners.spotlight: Hit the ground running for George Baker with 1m4f/1m3f wins on the AW and was close up at Epsom despite stumbling at the start; that was no backward step and he should be thereabouts.
runners.comment: 2-3 since joining George Baker and his close fourth at Epsom was no backward step

runners.name: Mrembo
runners.spotlight: Reliable mare who wasn't beaten far last time at Epsom when just behind Imperical Cult; has run well in the last three renewals of this race, beaten 2l or less; considered.
runners.comment: Reliable mare and has run well in the last three renewals of this race

runners.name: Pride Of Nepal
runners.spotlight: Went a long time without winning but then rattled off a four-timer (1m2f-1m4f) prior to a rather puzzling run at Epsom last week (finished last, beaten about 17l); that was a Class 4 but those four wins were Class 6s, so could be vulnerable off this mark even if back on song.
runners.comment: Puzzling run last week but could be vulnerable off this mark even if back on song

runners.name: Golden Phase
runners.spotlight: Off since a quiet run on the AW in December and that was after 147 days away so current wellbeing is an issue; however, only 3lb higher than when making all at Salisbury last summer (1m2f, good to firm) so not handicapped out of it.
runners.comment: On a competitive mark but quiet in just one run since last July

races.race_name: Chasemore Farm EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Delighfully Hot
runners.spotlight: No match for the long odds-on winner at Wolverhampton (5f) where Elpeeare was a bigger eye-catcher in finishing hot on this one's heels.
runners.comment: Not certain to confirm latest AW placings with Elpeeare

runners.name: Downonmainstreet
runners.spotlight: Seventh of ten, beaten about 5l, over 6f at Yarmouth a month ago; raced prominently before weakening and may do better with the outing under her belt, now dropped to 5f.
runners.comment: Seventh of ten, beaten about 5l, over 6f at Yarmouth a month ago; may do better
runners.owner: Mrs Paul Shanahan & Mrs M V Magnier

runners.name: Elpeeare
runners.spotlight: 95,000gns yearling; not a lot went right for her when a keeping-on third (just behind Delighfully Hot) at Wolverhampton (5f) so appeals as one who could leave that form behind; however, it could significant that Darragh Keenan rode that day but now partners her stablemate.
runners.comment: Not a lot went right for her when a keeping-on third at Wolverhampton

runners.name: Not My Type
runners.spotlight: No Nay Never filly and the first foal out of a 6f winner (RPR 96) and sister to 6f winner Craved; the betting should offer clues as to expectations.
runners.comment: No Nay Never filly and the first foal out of a 6f winner and sister to 6f winner Craved

runners.name: Bint Palace Pier
runners.spotlight: Palace Pier filly who cost 110,000euros yearling and is half-sister to winners Fort Rock (7f 2yo; RPR 95), Nubuck (French 12.5f; 91) and Chuck Taylor (6f-1m1f; 69); dam a useful 1m winner; interesting debutante for a yard that had a successful newcomer last week.
runners.comment: Palace Pier filly who cost 110,000euros yearling; interesting newcomer

runners.name: Duty's Call
runners.spotlight: £110,000 yearling by Mehmas; first foal out of a 5f winner (Listed; RPR 101) and half-sister to winners Volterra (Group 3-placed 7f/1m) and Inishbeg (7f); market support could be significant when the yard's 2yos have been going great guns.
runners.comment: £110,000 yearling by Mehmas; first foal out of a 5f Listed winner

runners.name: Sarasota Blue Blue
runners.spotlight: 175,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to winners Manatee Mehmas (5f; RPR 95) and Tiva (5f; 86); dam placed 6f (including 2yo; 71), closely related to 6f Group 2 winner Tasleet and Group-placed 6f 2yo winner Aspect Island; stable searching for first 2yo winner of the year but she's of interest on paper.
runners.comment: Stable searching for first 2yo winner of the year but she's of interest on paper

runners.name: Coconut Stall
runners.spotlight: 65,000gns foal by Showcasing; half-sister to winners Calafiori (5f-8.5f; RPR 79) and Mechayekh (1m); dam 6f winner and half-sister to winners Go Angellica (1m 2yo Listed) and Southern Belle (useful 5f/6f); doesn't have the best of draws, especialy for a newcomer.
runners.comment: 65,000gns foal by Showcasing and out of a 6f winner

runners.name: Nightbloom
runners.spotlight: 400,000euros yearling; beaten 11l when made favourite at Beverley (5f) but her inexperience was evident from the outset and should be all the wiser this time; tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Inexperience evident from the outset when only sixth at Beverley

races.race_name: Close Brothers Premium Finance Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Personal Best
runners.spotlight: Ground this fast is a nagging concern but she's building up some momentum this season and was nailed late on over C&D 41 days ago; only had the 12 races and she's consistent.
runners.comment: Building up some momentum this season and was nailed late on over C&D last time
runners.owner: Hot To Trot 1 & Mrs R Pease

runners.name: Laravie
runners.spotlight: Completed a top-of-the-ground hat-trick this year (1m6f-2m1f) and remains in good form, as a tactical race wouldn't have suited at Yarmouth and she was never ideally positioned after starting slowly last time (finished 8.5l behind the winner); another to consider.
runners.comment: Completed a hat-trick this year and remains in good form after recent seconds

runners.name: Knight Templar
runners.spotlight: In good form over hurdles and on the Flat earlier this year, last time going close in a 2m AW handicap off 1lb lower; if in the same form after his break then should be involved.
runners.comment: In good form over hurdles and on Flat earlier this year; if sharp enough should have a say

runners.name: Mister Daydream
runners.spotlight: Dual turf winner at 1m2f and 1m3f for Charlie Johnston last spring; back to form in winning a 1m4f selling handicap on the AW earlier this month and was then second under a penalty; 3lb higher now but should be fine back on turf.
runners.comment: Back to form on the AW and he should be fine returned to turf

runners.name: Ludo's Landing
runners.spotlight: Strike-rate of 7-50; won off this mark in March but well beaten in three of his four subsequent runs and has become hard to predict.
runners.comment: Well beaten in three of his last four runs and has become hard to predict

runners.name: Appier
runners.spotlight: Career win number 11 when coming clear at Goodwood (1m6f, soft) on his debut for Tony Carroll; effective on faster ground and a 6lb rise might not stop him if he's turned a corner.
runners.comment: Came clear at Goodwood (1m6f, soft) on his debut for Tony Carroll; back up 6lb

races.race_name: Close Brothers Handicap

runners.name: Hot And Cold
runners.spotlight: Novice winner at two; always doing enough for a successful handicap debut at Salisbury and then denied late on at Ascot (again at 1m on good to firm), where she dictated a steady pace; had no excuses that day but this longer trip should help, as she's out of a 1m4f winner.
runners.comment: Progressive this year at 1m and she's out of a 1m4f winner, so this trip can bring her on

runners.name: Cyrano De Bergerac
runners.spotlight: 150,000gns yearling by Palace Pier; all races at 1m2f, getting off the mark in comfortable style at the expense of two rivals at Nottingham (good); brings potential into handicaps and connections won this last year.
runners.comment: Won a soft race last time but brings potential into handicaps

runners.name: Blue Noon
runners.spotlight: Showed clear promise in novice/maiden events; doesn't appear to have anything up her sleeve mark-wise after two defeats in handicaps (at about 1m2f) and contested a lower-grade race last time.
runners.comment: Two handicap defeats; doesn't appear to have anything up her sleeve mark-wise

runners.name: Roker Roar
runners.spotlight: The close fourth at Newcastle in November is his standout run and disappointed favourite backers the last time; however, now gelded ahead of this handicap debut and would command respect if at all strong in the betting.
runners.comment: Gelded ahead of handicap debut and would command respect if at all strong in the betting

runners.name: Knightsail
runners.spotlight: Not that threatening in his qualifying races (1m1f-1m2f) but showed ability and the potential is there to improve for a gelding operation; also hooded for this handicap debut; market helpful.
runners.comment: Promise in his three races; gelded since; hood also added for handicap debut

races.race_name: Close Brothers Invoice Finance Handicap

runners.name: Cristo
runners.spotlight: First turf win when a neck victor over C&D earlier this month (good) and might have followed up off this 3lb higher mark had he not been carried left late on at Windsor; 2lb higher in future; player.
runners.comment: C&D winner who looked unfortunate not to follow up at Windsor; same mark

runners.name: Swiped
runners.spotlight: Progressive in blinkers before switched to a visor and winning narrowly at Epsom (1m127yds); he did some hanging but that was probably due to the track; a 6lb rise seems hefty enough but he's trending in the right direction.
runners.comment: Progressive in blinkers before switched to a visor and winning narrowly at Epsom

runners.name: Lorca's Waltz
runners.spotlight: Gelded in February and made successful return to the track with a narrow verdict over Beverley's extended 7f (first-time tongue-tie), beating another well-bred 3yo with potential; that could be a springboard to better things in handicaps.
runners.comment: Maiden win could be a springboard to better things in handicaps
runners.owner: HM The King & HM The Queen

runners.name: Sea Suite
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been at 7f but has form over this far and it might yet end up being his best trip; due a 1lb rise after finding one too good at Yarmouth last time (7f); unlikely to be too far away.
runners.comment: Due a 1lb rise after finding one too good at Yarmouth last time; unlikely to be far away

runners.name: Winston's Warrior
runners.spotlight: Both wins on the AW but he bled when disappointing at Nottingham before a solid 2l defeat in a big field at Ascot (7f, good to firm); he was boxing on that day and now returns to a mile; respected.
runners.comment: Boxing on when a 2l fifth at Ascot and now returns to 1m; respected

runners.name: Bubbles Wonky
runners.spotlight: Dual winner on turf for Tim Easterby; has dropped to a good mark and close up in a couple of Class 5s over 1m at Kempton; likely to need more here.
runners.comment: Close up in a couple of Class 5s over 1m at Kempton; likely to need more here

races.race_name: On The River Ball+Chain Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Absolute Diamond
runners.spotlight: Well held in a Kempton novice (6f, AW) 16 days ago, but had shown ability in two starts on turf last month including when chasing home a nice prospect on her debut over C&D (good to soft; third has won since); this may not take much winning on nursery debut and she's high on the list.
runners.comment: Held on AW last time but promise in both starts on turf; high on the list on nursery debut

runners.name: So Tempting
runners.spotlight: Out of the frame in three novices on turf/AW, though there has been a glimmer of ability; not dismissed on nursery debut if the cheekpieces bring about some improvement.
runners.comment: Has shown a glimmer of ability; makes nursery debut with cheekpieces on

runners.name: Havananother
runners.spotlight: Well held in all three starts, finishing behind three of today's rivals in the process; lots more needed now switched to a nursery.
runners.comment: Well held in all three starts; lots more needed now switched to a nursery

runners.name: Devon Angel
runners.spotlight: Improved on previous efforts when third of five on nursery debut at Ffos Las (5f, good; carried 2lb overweight) ten days ago; shaped as though this extra furlong would suit, but the first-time tongue-tie she wore then is now missing.
runners.comment: Third of five on nursery debut and 6f should suit, but tongue-tie worn then is now missing

runners.name: Il Capo
runners.spotlight: Hasn't figured in three starts over 6f/7f on turf/AW; bred to be better than he has shown and wouldn't be a big surprise to see improvement now switched to a nursery.
runners.comment: Hasn't figured in three starts, but bred to be better than he has shown; nursery debut

runners.name: Dreams Galore
runners.spotlight: Showed some ability on last month's Nottingham debut (5f, good), but has gone backwards in two starts since including over C&D (good to soft); bred to be better than that and interesting to see how she fares in the market on nursery debut compared to stablemate Sovereign Beach.
runners.comment: Mildly promising debut, but has gone backwards since; nicely bred though; nursery debut

runners.name: Sovereign Beach
runners.spotlight: Little to get excited about in her first three starts and failed to beat a rival at Newbury (6f, good to firm) last time; may improve for the switch to a nursery but will need to; hood removed after one use.
runners.comment: Little to get excited about in her first three starts; needs to improve on nursery debut

races.race_name: Apex Transport Planning Summer Sunset EBF Restricted Maiden (Band D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive)

runners.name: Forest Berry
runners.spotlight: Beaten a length into second of 12 on her second start over C&D in May (good to soft), but did too much early when fourth of ten at Lingfield (6f, AW) last month; one for the shortlist provided she settles better and copes with the quicker surface.
runners.comment: Runner-up over C&D in May but did too much early last time; shortlisted if settling better

runners.name: Temple Court
runners.spotlight: Has shown ability in his last two starts and did well to finish third of seven here (7f, good to firm) 16 days ago given his jockey rode most of the race with a broken rein; major contender.
runners.comment: Has shown ability in his last two starts and did well to finish third here last time

runners.name: Defiant Dream
runners.spotlight: Improved from last month's AW debut when second of five at Ffos Las (5f, soft) 13 days later; that form has worked out quite well and a player if she can repeat it back up a furlong on constrasting ground.
runners.comment: Improved from her debut when second of five at Ffos Las; a player if she can repeat it

runners.name: Evangeline Adams
runners.spotlight: April foal by Perfect Power; 13,000gns yearling; dam placed 7f 2yo/1m3f (RPR 73), sister to winners Alhebayeb (6f 2yo Group 2), Azmaam (useful 7f 2yo/1m) and Silver Mission (6f-10.5f), half-sister to 5f Listed winner Humidor; stable not a noted source of winning 2yo newcomers.
runners.comment: Stable not a noted source of winning 2yo newcomers

runners.name: Zonneveld
runners.spotlight: March foal by Showcasing; brother to Italian 9.5f-11.5f winner Navajo Scout (including AW), half-brother to winners Ayr Harbour (7f/1m AW; RPR 105) and Desert Lion (1m-1m2f including AW/KSA; 104); dam 7f and 7.5f (Italian Listed) 2yo winner (103); already gelded and stable (also responsible for Napps Way) has few 2yos go in first time.
runners.comment: Already gelded and stable has few 2yos go in first time
runners.owner: M Reddy, J Mallon, N J Clayton & Partner

runners.name: Napps Way
runners.spotlight: March foal by Twlight Son; 2,500gns yearling; dam unplaced 7f/1m (RPR 64), half-sister to 1m winner Mumtaaz, out of unraced half-sister to winners Izzi Top (1m2f Group 1), Jazzi Top (1m2f Group 2) and Emaraaty (smart 7f-8.5f); stable doesn't have many winning 2yo newcomers.
runners.comment: Stable doesn't have many winning 2yo newcomers

runners.name: Cruzcampo Cai
runners.spotlight: March foal by Ubettabelieveit; 5,000gns yearling; dam 7f AW winner (RPR 63), closely related to 7f/1m winner Finbar's Lad, half-sister to 7f 2yo Group 3 winner Pleaseletmewin, out of 7f winning half-sister to 1m4f Group 1 winner Rainbow Peak; wouldn't look an obvious winner on debut.
runners.comment: Wouldn't look an obvious winner on debut

runners.name: Dissenter
runners.spotlight: Not without support when beaten just over 2l into fifth of 11 on this month's Bath debut (5.7f, firm); shortlisted if coming on from that run.
runners.comment: Beaten just over 2l into fifth of 11 on this month's Bath debut; shortlisted

runners.name: Bossy Angel
runners.spotlight: No show in her first two starts, but not disgraced when fifth of nine at Windsor (6f, good to firm; 125-1) 11 days ago; nurseries are still likely to provide a better option, though.
runners.comment: Not disgraced at Windsor last time, but nurseries still likely to provide a better option

runners.name: Beechwood Glory
runners.spotlight: Sent off 33-1 but hinted at ability when beaten less than 4l into fifth of eight on last month's Nottingham debut (6f, good to firm); open to progress but it will be needed.
runners.comment: Hinted at ability when fifth of eight on last month's Nottingham debut; improvement needed

races.race_name: Cheeseburger Aaron Handicap

runners.name: Prefer The Sister
runners.spotlight: Has been flying since joining this yard (231211), her last two wins coming in this headgear combination with Mason Paetel aboard; races off a 5lb lower mark than when landing a Newmarket apprentice handicap (7f, good to firm) a week ago (9lb well in) and should take all the beating.
runners.comment: In cracking form for this yard and 5lb lower than when winning a week ago (9lb well in)

runners.name: Sioux Warrior
runners.spotlight: Doubled his winning tally when beating four rivals (including Too Much Trevor) over C&D (good to firm) 16 days ago; only 2lb higher and may be the one to capitalise if Prefer The Sister runs below form.
runners.comment: 2lb higher than when winning over C&D last time; chance if the likely favourite misfires

runners.name: On Key
runners.spotlight: Consistent in recent months, but was having his 25th outing when off the mark at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) ten days ago; 3lb wrong under his 5lb penalty and likely to find one or two too strong.
runners.comment: Off the mark at the 25th attempt last time; 3lb wrong under penalty; others stronger

runners.name: Too Much Trevor
runners.spotlight: Just 2-34, though both wins have come here since the start of last month; 2lb wrong under a 5lb penalty for his narrow C&D success (good to firm) eight days ago, though is just 4lb higher; each-way claims given his liking for the track.
runners.comment: Dual course winner in the past two months; each-way claims given his liking for the track

runners.name: Francisco
runners.spotlight: Both wins on the AW, the latest at Lingfield (7f) in April; twice well held since despite just a 2lb rise and others make greater appeal.
runners.comment: Twice well held since winning on the AW in April; others make greater appeal

runners.name: Auburn Avenue
runners.spotlight: Placed several times over further in Ireland, but twice out of the frame since returning for this yard last month and is now 0-17; little appeal.
runners.comment: Twice out of the frame since returning for this yard and now 0-17; little appeal

runners.name: Brave Byreflection
runners.spotlight: 12lb lower than when winning a three-runner affair over C&D (good to firm) for Alice Haynes just over a year ago, but hasn't been threatening to take advantage of her sliding mark including in three starts for this yard; look elsewhere.
runners.comment: 12lb below last winning mark, but hasn't been threatening to take advantage

races.race_name: LSL Racing Horse Sales Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Eutropia
runners.spotlight: Three wins over 1m/1m2f on turf/AW in the spring and has only gone down narrowly in her last two starts, the latest at Epsom (8.5f, good to firm) eight days ago; already due to go up another 3lb for that and holds leading claims.
runners.comment: Has only gone down narrowly in her last two starts; already due a 3lb rise; leading claims

runners.name: Nammos
runners.spotlight: Only 2lb higher than when winning at Bath (1m, firm) in May and only beaten 2l into fifth of eight over C&D (good to firm) 16 days ago (fourth has won since); not discounted.
runners.comment: Just 2lb above her last winning mark and not beaten far here last time; not discounted

runners.name: Rating
runners.spotlight: Beaten just over a length into third of six behind Kodi Fire over C&D (good to firm) eight days ago; didn't enjoy a clear run there and now 5lb better off, but her modest strike-rate is a concern.
runners.comment: Closely matched with Kodi Fire on recent C&D running, but modest strike-rate is a concern

runners.name: Dapper Gee Gee
runners.spotlight: Dual winner over 7f at this track, the latest (good to soft) in May; has one good run against his name over this far, but on balance shorter trips seem to suit him best and he may also prefer slower ground.
runners.comment: Dual course winner, but shorter trips and slower ground seem to suit him best

runners.name: Spirit Of The Bay
runners.spotlight: Was back off her last winning mark when beaten a neck at Ffos Las (7.4f, good) ten days ago, doing very well to go so close following a poor start; should be bang there granted a cleaner break this time; stable also runs Nammos.
runners.comment: Looked unlucky not to win at Ffos Las ten days ago; still on last winning mark

runners.name: Darvel
runners.spotlight: 3lb higher than when winning this race last year, but is off the same mark as when following up at Salisbury (1m, good to soft) next time; looked unlucky not to go even closer when third of eight at Epsom (8.5f, good to firm) 15 days ago and is respected.
runners.comment: Won this last year and still off last winning mark, despite recent 1lb rise; respected

runners.name: Kodi Fire
runners.spotlight: Fast-ground specialist who completed a hat-trick around this time last year and was back off his last winning mark when making all over C&D (good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) eight days ago; 2lb wrong under a 5lb penalty, but still respected now that he is back in the groove.
runners.comment: Fast-ground specialist; made all over C&D eight days ago; respected despite 5lb penalty

races.race_name: 3A's Caravan & Motorhome Classified Stakes

runners.name: Knightmare
runners.spotlight: 0-21, but on the plus side he has gone close in his last two starts and is the only one in the field with an official mark of 50; should run his race again.
runners.comment: 0-21, but is the only one in the field with an official mark of 50; should run his race

runners.name: Judge Frank
runners.spotlight: Two wins in September 2024 included one here (7f, good), but losing run now up to 14; drops to this level for the first time, which offers one ray of hope.
runners.comment: Losing run up to 14; drops to this level for the first time, which offers one ray of hope

runners.name: Fighting Queen
runners.spotlight: Made a successful handicap debut in a 0-60 contest at Bath (1m, firm) for Joe Ponting in May last year, but not built on it and her two efforts since returning this May have been poor; needs the change of stable and drop in class to make a big difference; yard also runs Judge Frank.
runners.comment: Poor since returning; needs change of scenery and drop in class to make a big difference

runners.name: A Rose Adaay
runners.spotlight: Placed in three of her nine starts, as when a staying-on third of eight dropped to this level at Ffos Las (7.4f, good) last time; frame possibilities again.
runners.comment: Placed in three of her nine starts as when third at Ffos Las last time; frame possible

runners.name: Star Of Atlantis
runners.spotlight: Both wins have come on the AW and she had no apparent excuses when midfield in a similar contest at Bath (1m, firm) last time; first-time hood replaces the usual cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Dual AW winner; no excuses when midfield in a similar contest at Bath last time; hood on

runners.name: Prince Ali
runners.spotlight: First six wins came on the AW, but he gained his first success on turf in a 0-55 handicap over C&D (soft) under Zoe Lewis (who knows him well) last month; drops to this level for the first time, but fast ground is a big question mark.
runners.comment: Won over C&D on soft ground last month; down in class but fast ground a big question mark

runners.name: Weston Court
runners.spotlight: 0-17 since winning twice over 1m in the summer of 2024, but he has run well in his last two visits in handicaps here (7f); each-way claims down in grade.
runners.comment: Has run well in his last two visits in handicaps here; each-way claims down in grade

runners.name: Fitzmaurice
runners.spotlight: Out of the frame in all 13 starts including when dropped to this level at Lingfield (1m, AW) 11 days ago; best watched until showing some spark; stable also runs Lady Margaret.
runners.comment: Out of the frame all 13 starts including when down to this level last time; best watched

runners.name: Strong Man Tom
runners.spotlight: Beaten miles in two bumpers and three starts over 1m2f on the Flat, including two here; tongue-tie given a go but only market support would make him of any interest.
runners.comment: Beaten miles in two bumpers and three starts over 1m2f on the Flat; tongue-tie on

runners.name: Lady Margret
runners.spotlight: Some ability on her debut over C&D a year ago, but didn't build on it including in two starts on the AW for this yard; worth a market check back from six months off.
runners.comment: Some ability on her debut over C&D a year ago, but didn't build on it; off six months

races.race_name: Sophie Busson Memorial Handicap

runners.name: So Smart
runners.spotlight: Took advantage of a drop in the weights when making all to record his second C&D success in an apprentice handicap (good to firm) eight days ago, beating stable-companion Savannah Smiles by 2l; races off the same mark (6lb well in) and a big chance of following up.
runners.comment: Made all over C&D eight days ago and races off the same mark (6lb well in); big chance

runners.name: Trafalger
runners.spotlight: Placed in five of his first six starts, but not so good in his last two outings including on stable debut after a lengthy absence at Windsor (6f, good to firm; 33-1) last month; down in grade but best watched for now.
runners.comment: Well held on last month's stable debut; down in grade but best watched for now

runners.name: River Edge
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who missed the whole of last year; not beaten far when last of four behind So Smart and Savannah Smiles over C&D (good to firm) eight days ago and 1lb better off with the pair, but he still needs to find a bit more.
runners.comment: Not beaten far behind two of these over C&D eight days ago, but needs to find a bit more

runners.name: Sundiata Keita
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on some of last season's form, but failed to beat a rival on stable debut after nine months off here (7f, good to firm) 16 days ago; others preferred.
runners.comment: Failed to beat a rival on stable debut after nine months off here 16 days ago

runners.name: Son Of Astar
runners.spotlight: 2lb lower than for the latest of three wins last year, but this season's form has been patchy and the suitability of ground faster than good is still to be established.
runners.comment: 2lb below last winning mark, but suitability of fast ground is still to be established

runners.name: Level Up
runners.spotlight: Losing run up to 16, but often placed and has finished runner-up in his last three starts off this mark, the latest a neck defeat at Beverley (5f, good to firm) on Monday; no reason why he shouldn't run his race again.
runners.comment: Losing run up to 16, but finished runner-up in his last three starts; should run his race

runners.name: Savannah Smiles
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner over 5f/6f here; finished 2l behind stablemate So Smart over C&D eight days ago and meets him on the same terms, but she lost ground at the start when the blindfold was removed late so she may get closer.
runners.comment: Had excuses when beaten 2l by stablemate So Smart over C&D last time; may get closer

runners.name: Brodie's Boy
runners.spotlight: Didn't run badly when fourth of nine in an apprentice handicap at Newbury (1m3f, good to firm) on his penultimate start, but is just 1-26 and most of his best form has come on the AW.
runners.comment: Just 1-26 and most of his best form has come on the AW

runners.name: Time For Action
runners.spotlight: First and second in two nurseries at Bath (1m, soft) last October, but not much otherwise and finished tailed off on her reappearance over that C&D (good) last month; best watched for now.
runners.comment: Tailed off on last month's Bath reappearance; best watched for now

runners.name: Midnight Media
runners.spotlight: In good form on the AW lately, getting off the mark at the seventh attempt at Wolverhampton (8.6f) this month; 4lb rise is fair enough, but she ran poorly in her only start on turf at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm) in May which does leave her with questions to answer.
runners.comment: Off the mark on the AW last time, but ran poorly in one start on turf; questions to answer

runners.name: City Escape
runners.spotlight: Knows more about this game than most with this being her 80th start, but she hasn't been running like a winner waiting to happen and hasn't scored on turf since September 2023.
runners.comment: Not running like a winner waiting to happen and hasn't scored on turf since September 2023

runners.name: Fozzy Osbourne
runners.spotlight: Well held in his first three starts, but was only beaten a neck and a nose into third of eight on handicap debut here (1m, good to firm) 16 days ago (fourth has won since); should stay this far and this unexposed sort is high on the list.
runners.comment: Finished a close third on handicap debut over 1m here last time; should stay this far

runners.name: All About George
runners.spotlight: Out of the frame in all seven starts and cheekpieces have made no difference; look elsewhere.
runners.comment: Out of the frame in all seven starts and cheekpieces have made no difference

runners.name: Crimson Road
runners.spotlight: Losing run up to 14, but now 22lb below his last winning mark and showed a bit more when fourth of nine at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm) last time; that form is working out quite well and one to be interested in.
runners.comment: 22lb below his last winning mark and showed a bit more when fourth at Nottingham last time

runners.name: Tiger Beetle
runners.spotlight: 3-27 on the AW and 1-22 on turf; 18lb below last winning mark, but offered little encouragement when beating one home over C&D (good to soft) last month.
runners.comment: 1-22 on turf; offered little encouragement when beating one home over C&D last month

runners.name: Prophet Squeeze
runners.spotlight: Hasn't shown much under either code and refused to race at Ffos Las ten days ago; easily overlooked.
